title: Family (Case) Manager
description:
We are looking for a Case (Family) Manager to enhance the quality of client management, maximize satisfaction, and promote cost-effectiveness. The successful candidate will be accountable for the full client care cycle. Case (Family) Manager duties include assessing, planning, implementing, monitoring, and evaluating actions required to meet the child's health and human services needed. A certified Case Manager is a plus.


Job Classification: Family Manager

Job Type: Full Time

Salary: $20 plus Benefits


PLEASE READ THE REQUIREMENTS FOR THIS POSITION PRIOR TO APPLYING.


Must pass a full FBI/Adam Walsh/ and CANS background check through the Department of Family Services. Background check costs are not reimbursed.


  • If you have any previous arrests within the last 7 years that are not only limited to DUIs, CPS, or Domestic Violence you DO NOT qualify for this position.
  • Employer randomly drug tests (Including Marijuana) No Exceptions


Take Note: This position will require you to obtain a full DFS County background and Reference check, Nevada Residence fee is $45, and out-of-state residents relocating to Nevada will have additional fees, TB, CPR, and internal testing before beginning your contract with the agency. title: Senior UI/UX Designer
description:
At Secret Door, we believe some of our best memories come from shared experiences with friends. We make games designed to bring people together, and we're looking for a Senior UI/UX Designer who shares our passion for creating thoughtful, engaging player experiences.

We're looking for a versatile Designer who can bring together UX design, UI art, and hands-on implementation in a game engine. You'll help shape how players interact with our games, from exploring early concepts and refining user flows to creating polished interface art and bringing those designs to life in-engine. You'll have the opportunity to make meaningful contributions across the development process, collaborate closely with a multidisciplinary team, and help shape the player experience in games built around shared experiences and play. You would be joining Secret Door at an exciting stage of development as we prepare Shadowstone for Early Access in late 2026, and would play an important role in refining and polishing the game's UI/UX as we approach this milestone, with the opportunity to contribute to other projects as our development efforts evolve.


What You Will Do

  • Design intuitive player experiences by creating wireframes, user flows, prototypes, and interaction designs that make gameplay and navigation feel seamless and intuitive
  • Develop visually polished interface elements and help establish a cohesive visual language for game UI, from individual components to complete screens and menus
  • Implement UI and UX designs directly in-engine, working hands-on to ensure interfaces function as intended and meet quality expectations
  • Develop and adapt interface experiences for PC and mobile, with consideration for console where applicable
  • Evaluate gameplay and interface experiences, identify opportunities for improvement, and refine solutions through prototyping, testing, and iteration
  • Help define UI/UX principles, workflows, and processes that make design decisions clear and actionable for the broader team


What We Need

  • Professional experience designing UI and player experiences for video games, with an understanding of the unique challenges of interactive products
  • Strong UX design skills paired with the ability to create polished UI art
  • Experience implementing UI in a game engine, ideally Unity, and collaborating with Engineers to deliver functional, polished interfaces
  • Experience designing for PC and mobile is especially valuable. Experience with console interfaces is a plus
  • Proficiency with Figma for creating wireframes and interactive prototypes, along with Photoshop, Illustrator, or equivalent tools for creating and refining UI assets
  • Ability to take ownership of your work, navigate ambiguity, communicate proactively, and work effectively with a small, multidisciplinary team.
  • A player-first perspective with a desire to create interfaces that support and enhance the overall play experience



Application Materials

  • Please include a resume, cover letter and portfolio with relevant game UI/UX samples



The base salary range for this position is $104,591 to $174,318 USD per year, which is associated with our Level 3 salary band. The range listed for this position is just one component of Dreamhaven’s total compensation package for team members and exact compensation may vary based on skills and experience. Total compensation also includes comprehensive benefits.

Secret Door is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to fostering a respectful, welcoming workplace where everyone has the opportunity to contribute and succeed.

title: Flat Sheet & Tube Laser Operator
location: North Kansas City, Missouri, United States
description:
AES Manufacturing is looking for a CNC Laser Operator to run flat-sheet and tube laser equipment
used to produce components for our safety products. The operator is responsible for safe setup,
material verification, machine operation, cut quality, part handling, basic troubleshooting, and routine
maintenance. Depending on production needs and experience, the primary machine assignment may
be flat sheet, tube laser, or both.


What You Will Do

  • Set up and operate AES flat-sheet fiber laser and tube laser equipment according to work orders, programs,
    and prints.
  • Verify correct material type, thickness, tube/profile size, orientation, and quantity before processing.
  • Safely load sheet, tube, pipe, or structural profiles using loaders, cranes, forklifts, or other approved handling
    equipment.
  • Monitor cutting performance and make approved adjustments to maintain cut quality and production
    efficiency.
  • Remove completed parts, separate sheet skeletons, de-tab, deburr, package, label, and stage parts as
    required.
  • Inspect cut dimensions, features, and overall quality using tape measures, calipers, gauges, and prints.
  • Clean optics and perform routine machine maintenance, consumable checks, and housekeeping.
  • Troubleshoot routine cutting, material-feed, and machine issues within the operator role and escalate larger
    problems promptly.
  • Track job times, quantities, scrap, and material utilization in AES production systems.
  • Communicate when material, gases, consumables, or tooling are running low.
  • Support other fabrication equipment or shop duties when production needs require and training allows.


What We Are Looking For

  • Ability to read technical drawings, work orders, and dimensions.
  • Ability to read a tape measure to 1/32 inch and work with decimal measurements.
  • Ability to identify carbon steel, stainless steel, aluminum, material thicknesses, and common tube/profile
    sizes.
  • Strong attention to machine safety, material handling, cut quality, and part identification.
  • Ability to work independently in an environment with changing priorities.
  • Reliable attendance and willingness to work outside the primary machine assignment when needed.


Experience That Helps

  • One or more years of CNC laser experience preferred, especially fiber laser or tube laser.
  • Two or more years in manufacturing or metal fabrication.
  • Mazak and BODOR fiber laser experience is a plus.
  • Experience with CNC controls, nesting/program interfaces, cranes, forklifts, and production software.
  • Basic machine troubleshooting and preventive-maintenance experience.

What AES Offers

  • Health, dental, and vision insurance.
  • Additional company-paid and voluntary benefits according to current AES plan terms.
  • Paid holidays and paid time off.
  • 401(k) with company match.
  • Full-time, year-round manufacturing work.
  • Opportunities to cross-train and grow into higher-skill manufacturing roles.


Career Growth
Laser operators can progress into advanced setup, tube/flat-sheet cross-training, CNC programming support,
press brake/folding beam, fabrication, quality, robotic/automation support, or senior operator/lead
responsibilities.

Qualified candidates will be invited to tour AES and complete a practical laser/CNC skills discussion or
assessment covering print reading, material identification, measurement, setup logic, quality, and
troubleshooting.

title: Shelter Manager
description:
The main mission of the City Rescue Mission of Lansing, since its founding, has remained to teach the Word of God as found in the Christian Bible (Romans 10:13-15), edify and equip the saints to be committed followers of Jesus Christ and His teachings (Ephesians 4:11-13), and present an authentic representation of traditional, Biblical Christianity (Philippians 1:9-11). For this reason, employees will be guided by the Doctrinal Statement established by the Board of Directors.



Mission Statement: To meet physical needs for Food and Shelter to bring those with spiritual needs the Hope that is found in Jesus Christ.



Vision Statement: To bring the lost to the Lord Jesus Christ and to establish believers in the Christian Faith.



Reports To: Director of Shelter



Job Overview: The Shelter Manager is a vital role in the success of the City Rescue Mission and the day-to-day operations of the shelters. This role oversees an assigned facility under the shelter umbrella of the City Rescue Mission. The Manager oversees day to day processes and things concerning the guests of the assigned facility. They are responsible for working with their director to ensure all processes, procedures, and efforts of the shelters are equitable and uniform and in line with the mission of Food, Shelter, and Hope. Ensuring guest tracking methods are being utilized properly, data and stats are accurate, all staff are treating guests appropriately and resolving guest concerns as necessary. The Manager must be able to multi-task effectively, work in an organized and efficient manner, balance communications with many different personality types, and problem solve frequently to ensure efficacy across all Shelter matters.


The current job opening is at the Single Adult Shelter.



Expected Schedule- Regularly 1st and 2nd, occasionally 3rd shift -Full Time, Exempt- Exact schedule varies by need and staffing. When shelters are fully staffed this role will include one to two 1st shift office days and three to four days working alongside staff, 1st or 2nd shift (5 days total). When there are schedule openings, the Manager will be expected to work with the Director to fill shifts as necessary across the shelter facilities. Weekends, Evenings, and Holidays (Rotation).



Responsibilities:

  • Be hands on in the training of all new shelter staff
  • Train new staff on guest tracking software
  • Work alongside the caseworker to handle guest discipline and daily life
  • Work with the Shelter Director to ensure all processes and procedures that take place within the shelter are effective and consistent.
  • Complete administrative tasks as assigned by the Shelter Director.
  • Assist Director with employee performance management.
  • Ensure staff are fulfilling their expectations, report issues that need escalated to the Director
  • Responsible for maintaining a smoothly run shelter, in accordance with Food, Shelter, and Hope
  • Maintain and encourage effective communication and collaboration, using all tools available
  • Attend all meetings and training sessions as scheduled
  • Show the love of Christ, be ready to share the gospel, teach in chapel, and pray with guests

Qualifications:

  • High School Diploma- Required
  • Proficient use of the Microsoft Suite- Required
  • 1+ Years Management/Supervisory Experience- Required
  • 1+ Year Shelter/Non-Profit Experience- Preferred

Skills

  • Ability to learn and teach a new computer program within 30 days of introduction
  • Ability to proficiently use a phone system that spans multiple facilities- including answering, transferring, putting calls on hold, etc. Within 15 days of introduction.
  • Ability to navigate, build, teach, and complete data entry in excel spreadsheets
  • Ability to respectfully interact with guests, volunteers, and staff no matter their background, temperament, preferences, or life choices
  • Detail oriented, organized, thorough, and possessing the ability to multitask well
  • Ability to constantly assess the accuracy, neatness, and thoroughness of all work assignments
  • Ability to de-escalate situations while staying calm under pressure

Foundation of Faith

  • Be ready at all times to give an answer of the Hope that lies within the committed follower of Christ, as outlined in the Christian Bible, with gentleness and respect (1 Peter 3:15).
  • Live everyday life in submission to the authority of the Christian Bible (2 Timothy 3:15-17).
  • Commit to continual training under those called to teach the doctrines of the faith and the Word of God, as well as to seek out fellowship with other believers (Hebrews 10:24-25), as evidenced by being a member in good standing in a local evangelical church.

Environment

The Shelter Manager will need to be able to work in a noisy and distraction-filled environment as needed. The Manager’s task will occasionally require them to work in low temperatures, high temperatures, outdoor elements (e.g. rain, wind, snow), and small/enclosed spaces.

Physical Requirements-

The below listed abilities are required to be able to complete the essential duties of the role:

The Shelter Manager will need to be able to constantly navigate stairs- quickly and proficiently navigating up to 3 flights of stairs whenever needed. They will constantly need to be able to lift 25lbs in all directions and will occasionally need to lift up to 50lbs. They will need to be able to complete 1+ hours of physically taxing work without a break and stand or walk for 3 hours without sitting down. They will occasionally need to complete 2-3 hours of physically taxing work without a break and be able to move with haste for 500ft.

The Shelter Manager will need to be able to constantly complete visual scans of indoor/outdoor areas in varying levels of light. They will need to constantly complete tasks with repetitive motions that include the wrists, hands and/or fingers. They will need to be able to constantly communicate clearly with others to exchange information.

Benefits:

  • Dental Insurance
  • Vision Insurance
  • Paid Sick Time
  • Christian Counseling Services
  • Health Insurance
  • Paid Vacation Days
  • Bereavement Leave

Be Aware- This Job Description serves to provide an overview of the role of Shelter Manager. It is not a task list and does not encompass all the details of this role. The employee will be expected to complete all tasks as assigned by the Shelter Director and serve as needed throughout the City Rescue Mission of Lansing.

title: WHS Officer, WHS
description:

title: Part-Time Program Coordinator - Elida, OH
description:
Code2College is dramatically increasing the number of minority and low-income high school students who enter and excel in STEM undergraduate majors and careers and is looking to hire a Part-Time
Program Coordinator to support its mission.

This is a hybrid position with in-person responsibilities for recruitment, events, and classes. Program coordinator will support in person courses.

OVERVIEW

As a Part-Time Program Coordinator, you will support a cohort of students and schools in Elida, Ohio and across the United States. You will support Code2College classes virtually and in person, lead student check-ins, support recruitment, and participate in Code2College events and other program activities.

RESPONSIBILITIES

Student & Program Support

  • Support a portfolio of student participants in Elida, Ohio and across the United States, serving as a consistent point of contact throughout their program experience.
  • Lead student check-ins, monitor engagement and participation, and provide follow-up and support as needed.
  • Support virtual and in-person Code2College classes, including observing classes and helping ensure students have the support they need to participate and succeed.
  • Draft and coordinate student-facing communications, reminders, and other program materials.
  • Support student recruitment and onboarding activities.

Program Data & Improvement

  • Track and analyze student-level performance and engagement data to identify meaningful insights and opportunities to improve program effectiveness.
  • Support programmatic projects and initiatives, including implementation, coordination, and follow-through.

Stakeholder Engagement

  • Build and maintain relationships with student participants, volunteer instructors, schools, and other stakeholders.
  • Help cultivate a strong sense of community within and across Code2College programs.
  • Support communication and coordination with program partners and other stakeholders.

Events & In-Person Programming

  • Participate in and support Code2College in-person events, including recruitment events, workshops, promotional events, partner events, and lunch and learns.
  • Support event preparation, execution, and follow-up as needed.

SCHEDULE & AVAILABILITY

  • Must be available Monday through Friday, 3:00–6:00 PM CST to support Code2College classes, with additional availability outside these hours for events and caseload responsibilities, for up to 30 hours per week.
  • Additional availability outside of these hours is required for student support, program responsibilities, and events.
  • This position is up to 30 hours per week.
  • May require occasional work outside of normal business hours and on Saturdays.
  • Other duties as assigned.

WHAT YOU’LL BRING

We are looking for someone who is early on in their career or looking to move into the non-profit education space, is eager to grow and develop, and is committed to our mission to equip minority and low-income high school students with the professional skills they need to excel in STEM degrees and careers.

  • You have a love of learning. You believe that your talents can be developed and you see feedback as an investment in your personal and professional growth.
  • You build trust and operate with integrity. You communicate openly and honestly when there is an issue so we can address it together.
  • You consider yourself a natural problem solver. You are always thinking about ways to do things better or differently, and you love to find solutions to tough problems.
  • You have an entrepreneurial spirit. You see yourself as a self-starter who is driven by setting and meeting goals, and getting better all the time. You are motivated by challenges and bounce back quickly from set-backs.
  • You prioritize outcomes over inputs and “why” over “what.”
  • You are driven by goals and data, and you see outcomes as your north star.
  • You consistently align yourself to the “why” of the work to determine the how and the what.

Additionally, to be successful at Code2College, you will be aligned with our core values:

  • Resourcefulness: we're a lean startup and none of us are experts; there are so many opportunities to leverage relationships, free and low-cost resources and communal assets to the betterment of our students and organization.
  • Urgency: the work that we do is important and every moment is an opportunity to change the lives of our students.
  • Transparency: we are candid with each other, share challenges as well as triumphs and have an orientation toward learning from our mistakes by talking about them openly.
  • Humility: every success is a team success and we're stronger as one unit; none of us can do this without the support of others.

Ideal candidates will have:

  • MUST live in the Elida, Ohio area.
  • Must have reliable transportation.
  • Willingness to work various evenings and weekends required.
  • Experience in a 6-12 setting prioritized.
  • Experience in an education setting is preferred.
  • Is flexible and open minded.
  • Experience working with a nonprofit or a startup is a plus.
  • A love for working with people, both adults and youth.
  • Has impeccable professionalism which will serve as a model for students.
  • Authorization to work in the United States required.

WHAT WE OFFER

The part-time work will include an hourly part-time rate of $15-20 per hour with a maximum of 30 hours per week. Your work days will be exclusive to Monday - Friday with occasional Saturday expectations for in-person events such as student recruitment and supplementary events, volunteer trainings and workshops. Benefits will not be extended for the part-time role.

HOW TO APPLY

Please submit your resume and tailored cover letter through our online application. We recommend including a cover letter that addresses your interest in Code2College’s mission and your fit for this opportunity. We also encourage interested candidates to apply as soon as possible as we are reviewing applications on a rolling basis.

ABOUT CODE2COLLEGE

Code2College is a growing non-profit organization based in Austin, TX with a mission to dramatically increase the number of minority and low-income high school students who enter and excel in STEM undergraduate majors and careers. These students often lack access to some of the most in-demand careers and technical industries. Further, the absence of opportunity to explore these areas through exposure to industry professionals, technical skills development, and at-bats to practically apply these skills has led to the dearth of diverse technical talent that we see today. We believe that through our approach to education, exposure, and experience, we can enhance student preparation for rigorous, technical careers and mitigate some of the key factors around STEM attrition. Code2College has served over 3,000 students since 2016 and we plan to have served over 8,000 students by 2024.


Code2College is an equal opportunity employer and an organization that values diversity. Code2College is committed to maintaining a non-discriminatory work environment and we do not discriminate against any employee or applicant for employment on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, gender, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, marital status, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression or any other personal characteristic protected by applicable law.

description:
General Manager

Lead Our Dallas Luxury Dog Resort

Location: Dallas, TX
Salary: $60,000 – $70,000 + Monthly Performance Bonus
Training: Two weeks in Los Angeles (all expenses paid)

A Leadership Opportunity with an Established Brand

An established Los Angeles luxury dog resort has expanded to Dallas, and we are seeking a General Manager to lead our Dallas location.

For more than a decade, our flagship facility in California has built a reputation for exceptional care, thoughtful design, and an environment where dogs can safely play, socialize, and relax under professional supervision. In Dallas, we’re looking for a strong operational leader to uphold those same standards of excellence and keep raising the bar.

This is an opportunity to lead a growing team, shape the culture of a brand-new facility, and grow a premium location in one of the country’s fastest-growing markets.

While a love of dogs is important, success in this role depends on strong leadership, operational discipline, and the ability to manage a busy multi-department service business.

About the Dallas Resort

Our Dallas location was designed from the ground up to provide a premium environment for dogs, including:

  • Private overnight boarding suites
  • Fully supervised cage-free daycare playgroups
  • Spacious indoor and outdoor play areas
  • Synthetic turf yards designed for safety and cleanliness
  • Shaded cabanas and enrichment areas
  • Wading pools for warm Texas days
  • Comfortable indoor spaces for rest and relaxation

Every element of the resort is designed to deliver a high-quality hospitality-level experience for both dogs and their owners.

What We Offer

  • $60,000 – $70,000 annual salary (depending on experience)
  • Monthly performance bonus
  • Medical, dental, and vision benefits (after eligibility period)
  • Paid time off and employee discounts
  • Complimentary daycare and boarding for your own dog
  • Two weeks of paid training in Los Angeles (travel and lodging included)
  • Growth opportunities as the company expands to additional locations

The Role

As General Manager, you will take ownership of the day-to-day operations of the Dallas resort and lead the development of a high-performing team.

This role is ideal for a hands-on operations leader who enjoys managing complex facilities, developing staff, and delivering exceptional guest experiences in a fast-paced service environment.

Candidates who succeed in this position typically come from hospitality, operations, or multi-department service environments where they have experience maintaining high service standards and leading diverse teams.

Key Responsibilities

  • Oversee daily operations across all departments: Daycare, Boarding, Grooming, Front Office, and Facilities
  • Recruit, hire, train, and develop a strong local team
  • Conduct performance reviews and provide ongoing leadership and coaching
  • Build strong client relationships and resolve service concerns professionally

  • Experience using business management software (Gingr experience is a plus)

Training

Overview of the role:


Ensure accurate and reliable business reporting through the execution of robust, well-controlled financial closing processes, maintaining consistency, compliance, and integrity across all reporting activities.


What you will do:


  • Financial Reporting & Closing
    • Lead and ensure the timely and accurate completion of monthly, quarterly, and annual financial close activities.

title: Graphic Designer & Photographer
description:
This search is being conducted by Flex HR on behalf of TISAS Arms Corp. Qualified candidates should submit a resume and portfolio within.

Flex HR uses AI for document preparation and meeting transcription only — never to screen or evaluate candidates. All hiring decisions are made by a human recruiter. Roles may be posted on platforms like Indeed or LinkedIn, which are independent companies that may use AI in their own technology.

JOB DESCRIPTION

Graphic Designer & Photographer

TISAS Arms Corp · Onsite - Buford, GA · Full-Time · Salaried Exempt · Reports to VP of Marketing

FLSA CLASSIFICATION

This is a full-time position classified as Salaried Exempt under the Fair Labor Standards Act — specifically the Creative Professional exemption (29 CFR § 541.302), based on the role's primary duty of performing work requiring invention, imagination, originality, and talent in the recognized creative fields of graphic design, photography, and visual arts. The employee is paid on a salary basis and is not eligible for overtime. The role is expected to be self-directed, with meaningful autonomy over creative decisions and daily prioritization.

About TISAS Arms Corp

TISAS Arms Corp is the U.S. operating division of TİSAŞ — Trabzon Silah Sanayi A.Ş. — a Turkish firearms manufacturer founded in 1993 and recognized worldwide for engineering quality, manufacturing precision, and competitive value. Best known for our extensive 1911 pistol line and growing portfolio of striker-fired pistols and modern sporting rifles, TISAS has become one of the most respected value-driven names in the U.S. firearms market. From our distribution facility in Buford, Georgia, we ship firearms direct from our Trabzon manufacturing facility to a growing dealer network across the United States.

Position Summary

We are looking for a rare kind of creative professional — a Graphic Designer & Photographer who owns the visual and creative identity of TISAS Arms Corp in the U.S. market. This is a high-autonomy, high-ownership role responsible for defining and executing how the TISAS brand shows up across every visual touchpoint: logos, social channels, product launches, dealer materials, trade show booths, brand collateral, web UX/UI, and product photography that bring modern brand storytelling to life. Video and motion graphics skills are a strong plus.

The Graphic Designer & Photographer exercises independent creative judgment on brand direction, campaign concepts, visual style, photographic treatments, and creative deliverables. This role is intentionally self-managed — you will not be told what colors to use, what shots to capture, or how to compose a piece of content. You will be trusted to translate business objectives into original, on-brand creative work that elevates TISAS in a crowded industry.

On any given day, you might shoot and retouch product photography in the morning, design a dealer one-pager in the afternoon, refine a sub-brand logo for a new product line, and prep social content for launch. You will partner with the CEO, Sales, Marketing (as the team grows), and TISAS HQ in Trabzon to bring the TISAS brand into sharper, more distinctive focus in the U.S. market.

We are being direct: this role is built around strength in graphic design and photography. Video and motion graphics are a genuine plus — candidates who also shoot and edit video will stand out — but they are not the core requirement. If you are a strong designer and photographer who thrives owning a brand rather than executing against someone else's brief, keep reading.

Key Responsibilities

Creative Vision and Direction

  • Own the TISAS Arms Corp visual identity in the U.S. market, including how it evolves over time to reflect new product lines, campaigns, and market positioning.
  • Exercise independent creative judgment on brand direction, campaign concepts, and creative deliverables — from initial concept through final execution.
  • Recommend and pitch original creative concepts to leadership; translate business objectives into distinctive creative work.
  • Self-manage creative workload and priorities in alignment with company launch calendars, trade show schedules, and marketing priorities.

Graphic Design and Brand

  • Design brand-consistent marketing collateral including product one-pagers, spec sheets, dealer materials, catalog pages, trade show graphics, digital ads, and print materials.
  • Create and refine original logos, sub-brand marks, and identity systems for new product lines, event campaigns, and internal initiatives.
  • Own and evolve the TISAS Arms Corp U.S. visual brand system: typography, color palette, iconography, photography style, and layout templates.
  • Design and direct product packaging elements, hangtags, and box inserts in partnership with Operations and TISAS HQ.

Photography and Product Imagery

  • Shoot product photography for the TISAS Arms Corp catalog, website, dealer materials, and social channels.
  • Edit and retouch product images to a consistent, on-brand standard.
  • Maintain and organize the TISAS Arms Corp master asset library (photos, videos, graphics, brand files) with clear file structure and version control.

Social Media Content Creation

  • Concept and produce platform-native content for Instagram, YouTube, TikTok, X, and other channels — designed for the format, not just resized for it.
  • Apply and evolve current social media best practices at TISAS: hook structure, retention, captioning, thumbnail design, cover selection, and platform-specific engagement patterns.
  • Partner with the Marketing Specialist (or CEO, in the absence of one) on content calendar planning, campaign concepts, and launch content — with meaningful creative authority in the creative direction of those campaigns.
  • Interpret social channel performance data and independently adjust creative approach based on what's working.

Brand, Compliance, and Collaboration

  • Protect and elevate the TISAS Arms Corp brand voice and visual identity across every deliverable.
  • Ensure all creative content complies with applicable federal and state firearms advertising restrictions, platform-specific firearms content policies, and TISAS Arms Corp's internal review standards.
  • Coordinate with the Compliance Manager on any creative involving regulated product claims, technical specifications, warranty language, or export-controlled information.
  • Coordinate with TISAS HQ in Trabzon to ensure U.S. creative is consistent with global brand standards and product positioning.
  • Support trade show booth design, environmental graphics, and event creative including SHOT Show and NRA Annual Meeting.

Video Production and Motion Graphics (Plus / Bonus)

  • Concept, plan, shoot, and edit product videos, brand videos, dealer training videos, event coverage, and social platform-first video content.
  • Operate camera, lighting, audio, and support equipment for in-house and on-location shoots (Buford facility, trade shows, dealer visits, and occasional TISAS HQ trips in Trabzon).
  • Edit in Adobe Premiere Pro (or comparable NLE), including color grading, sound design, and delivery for multiple output formats.
  • Create small-scale animations and motion graphics to support social content, video intros/outros, product feature highlights, and digital advertising.
  • Design animated logo treatments, kinetic type sequences, and short explainer animations.

Required Qualifications

  • Degree or diploma from an accredited college program in graphic design, visual communication, digital media, or a closely related creative discipline. This is a required qualification — self-taught candidates without formal design education will not be considered for this role.
  • 3–7 years of professional experience producing creative work at a company, agency, or as a full-time freelancer with a demonstrable client roster.
  • Strong professional portfolio demonstrating depth in graphic design (identity, layout, digital, print) and product photography; breadth into video production, motion graphics, or animation is a plus.
  • Fluency in Adobe Creative Suite, particularly Photoshop, Illustrator, and InDesign. Working knowledge of Premiere Pro and After Effects is a plus.
  • Hands-on proficiency with camera, lighting, and studio equipment for product photography; ability to plan and execute a photo shoot from concept to delivery.
  • Strong working knowledge of current social media best practices across Instagram, YouTube, TikTok, and X — including platform-native design principles, retention mechanics, and firearms industry advertising restrictions.
  • Excellent eye for typography, layout, hierarchy, color, and composition.
  • Strong project management skills; able to juggle multiple concurrent creative projects and deliver on deadline.
  • Eligible to possess firearms under federal law (18 U.S.C. § 922(g)) and Georgia law, as this role involves handling firearms for photography and product content creation.
  • U.S. work authorization (no sponsorship available). Must pass a comprehensive pre-employment background check and drug screen.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Prior creative experience in the firearms, sporting goods, hunting, outdoor, or defense industry.
  • Familiarity with firearms industry advertising restrictions, including Meta (Facebook/Instagram) and Google Ads firearms policies, and lawful compliant messaging.
  • Familiarity with the firearms media landscape, including major publications, YouTube channels, and industry influencers.
  • Video production and editing skills — Premiere Pro, shooting, and basic color grading.
  • Motion graphics familiarity — After Effects skills, 2D animation, kinetic typography, or cinema-quality title design.
  • 3D or product visualization skills — Blender, Cinema 4D, or similar for product renders, exploded views, or animated product reveals.
  • Studio and location lighting expertise for product photography (and video, if applicable).
  • Experience designing for e-commerce platforms and website content management systems (Shopify, WordPress, Webflow, or comparable).
  • Prior trade show or event creative experience (booth design, environmental graphics, event print).
  • Working knowledge of print production — file prep, color management, working with commercial printers.
  • Bilingual English/Spanish or English/Turkish.

Work Environment and Physical Requirements

This is a primarily on-site role at the TISAS Arms Corp distribution facility in Buford, Georgia. The role is not remote-eligible, though occasional flexibility may be available for specific project work such as edit-heavy days. The Graphic Designer & Photographer will spend time in office workspace (design and editing), warehouse or product staging areas (photography and video), and on the road for trade shows, dealer events, and location shoots.

  • Sitting at a workstation: Extended periods (up to 8 hours/day) for design and editing work.
  • Standing, walking, kneeling, lifting: Regular for shoot setup, lighting rigs, product staging, and location work.
  • Lifting: Ability to lift up to 40 pounds occasionally (camera gear, lighting, product cases, trade show materials).
  • Manual dexterity: Fine motor control for camera operation, cable management, and tool handling; strong eyesight (with or without correction) for detailed design work.
  • PPE: Safety glasses and hearing protection required when in the range or test-fire area for content capture; standard warehouse PPE when in warehouse zones.
  • Travel: Moderate (10–20%) for trade shows, dealer events, location shoots, and occasional visits to TISAS HQ in Trabzon, Türkiye. Peak travel around SHOT Show (January) and NRA Annual Meeting (spring).
  • Schedule: Core business hours are Monday through Friday, with flexibility to accommodate shoot schedules, product launch timelines, and trade show prep. Occasional early mornings, evenings, or weekend work will be required — reflected in the salaried nature of the role.

Compensation and Benefits

Pay Structure

This position is classified as Salaried Exempt under the Fair Labor Standards Act (Creative Professional exemption, 29 CFR § 541.302). The Graphic Designer & Photographer receives a fixed annual salary paid on a bi-weekly basis and is not eligible for overtime compensation.

  • Annual salary: $80,000 – $90,000, commensurate with experience, portfolio strength, and breadth of skill across design, photography, and (if applicable) video/motion.
  • Salary basis: Paid a predetermined amount each pay period, not subject to reduction based on the quality or quantity of work performed, except as permitted under FLSA § 541.602.

Benefits

  • Health, dental, and vision insurance with employer contribution to premiums.
  • 401(k) retirement plan with employer match (per plan eligibility).
  • Paid time off including vacation, sick leave, and recognized federal holidays.

title: Pipeline Patrol Pilot
description:
Pipeline Patrol Pilot – Nationwide Aerial Operations


We are seeking exceptional Commercial Pilots to join our nationwide flight operations team. This position is designed for aviators who want more than simply accumulating flight hours. It offers the opportunity to develop meaningful real-world experience while conducting specialized aerial missions across the United States.


Our pilots operate in a dynamic VFR environment supporting aerial patrol, inspection, and related mission-based flight operations. Assignments may take pilots throughout the country and require the ability to adapt to changing terrain, weather, airspace, and operational requirements. The result is challenging, hands-on flying that develops the judgment, precision, and situational awareness that distinguish highly capable professional aviators.

Successful candidates must hold a Commercial Pilot Certificate with an Airplane Single-Engine Land rating and Instrument Rating and have a minimum of 450 hours of total flight time.


Above all, safety, professionalism, and sound judgment are fundamental to our operation. We expect our pilots to approach every mission with preparation and discipline, exercise appropriate decision-making authority, and consistently place safe aircraft operation ahead of mission completion.


This is a full-time position for pilots who are prepared to make a meaningful commitment to the organization and their fellow teammates. Because our flight operation depends upon the reliability of every member of the team, we seek individuals who take personal responsibility for their assignments and understand the importance of being dependable in a professional aviation environment.


In return, pilots can expect consistent flying and substantial opportunities to expand their experience. For career-minded aviators, the position provides an opportunity to build flight time while developing practical skills that extend well beyond the logbook. Nationwide operations expose pilots to diverse airspace, airports, terrain, weather conditions, and mission profiles while strengthening the operational judgment required for advancement within the aviation industry.


Starting compensation is $23.00 per hour, with the volume of flying providing the opportunity for annual earnings exceeding $30,000.


The ideal candidate is safety-conscious, adaptable, dependable, and eager to become a stronger aviator through consistent operational experience.


For pilots seeking to build meaningful flight time while developing the skills, judgment, and experience necessary for the next stage of their aviation careers, this position offers an opportunity to do both as part of a professional nationwide flight operation.

title: Press Brake & Folding Beam Operator
location: North Kansas City, Missouri, United States
description:
AES Manufacturing is looking for a skilled Press Brake & Folding Beam Operator to produce accurate
formed metal parts. This role requires print reading, setup ability, tooling knowledge, measurement,
quality ownership, and safe machine operation. Experience on either CNC press brakes or folding
beam/panel bending equipment is valuable, and cross-training on both is encouraged.


What You Will Do

  • Set up and operate CNC press brakes and folding beam/panel bending equipment.
  • Read engineering drawings, work orders, bend details, dimensions, and fabrication prints.
  • Select and install appropriate tooling, dies, programs, and machine settings for each job.
  • Verify material type and thickness and plan bend sequence to produce parts safely and accurately.
  • Make approved machine adjustments, offsets, and corrections to hold dimensions and angles.
  • Measure and inspect finished parts using tape measures, calipers, gauges, squares, protractors, and
    templates as appropriate.
  • Identify quality problems and correct setup or process issues before producing additional nonconforming
    parts.
  • Perform routine machine care, tooling care, cleaning, and basic troubleshooting.
  • Track production accurately and communicate tooling, material, or machine problems promptly.
  • Work with laser, fabrication, welding, assembly, quality, and engineering to keep parts moving through
    production.


What We Are Looking For

  • Ability to read blueprints and technical drawings.
  • Understanding of metal bending, bend direction, tolerances, and dimensional inspection.
  • Ability to perform setups with limited supervision at the level hired.
  • Comfort using precision measuring tools and making controlled machine corrections.
  • Strong attention to quality, safety, and material handling.
  • Ability to work independently and adjust to high-mix production priorities.

    Experience That Helps
  • One to three or more years of press brake, folding beam, panel bender, or sheet-metal experience.
  • Experience with multiple machine controls, tooling systems, or materials.
  • CNC programming/setup experience.
  • High-mix, low-volume metal fabrication experience.
  • Experience working with parts produced by laser or punch equipment.

What AES Offers

  • Health, dental, and vision insurance
  • Additional company-paid and voluntary benefits according to current AES plan terms.
  • Paid holidays and paid time off.
  • 401(k) with company match.
  • Full-time, year-round manufacturing work.
  • Opportunities to cross-train and grow into higher-skill manufacturing roles.


Career Growth
Operators can progress into advanced setup/programming, cross-training on both press brake and folding
beam equipment, senior operator, fabrication, quality, training, or lead responsibilities.


How We Hire
Qualified candidates will be invited to tour AES and complete a practical press brake/folding beam assessment
focused on print reading, tooling/setup logic, bend sequence, measurement, corrections, and safe judgment.

title: Lead Software Engineer
description:
Building the intelligence behind Solskin

Are you a driven person who wants to make buildings come alive?

We are Zurich Soft Robotics (ZSR), a Zurich-based startup developing Solskin – a climate-adaptive solar facade. Solskin is not just a PV system or a shading system; it’s an intelligent skin that uses weather and building data, occupant feedback, and AI algorithms to decide how the facade moves, so buildings stay comfortable, avoid overheating, and use energy as efficiently as possible. Solskin is already running on several buildings across Switzerland, with many more to follow.

In this role, you own the software that makes that happen. You write the code that runs Solskin, keep it reliable in the field, and constantly improve it. You will also architect and lead our future sensor-to-data platform. Your focus is where software meets hardware, and the control and AI on top of it. You don't need to be a front-end specialist.

What you will do

This is a hands-on leadership position: you code every day.

Own the full stack: You maintain and develop the whole software stack, from cloud and data management to user-facing applications, and from low-level embedded firmware to high-level AI controllers learning from users. You keep it reliable and keep making it better.

Be the link between the teams: You build the software that runs on real buildings and support the hardware team. You also build the internal tools used by sales and the business team.

Lead what comes next: With the CEO and CTO, you set the software direction and lead development of future products.

Our stack:

  • Backend: Python, FastAPI, PyTorch

  • Frontend: React, TypeScript

  • Hardware: C/C++, STM32 microcontrollers, Beckhoff PLCs

  • Database: PostgreSQL (TimescaleDB)

  • DevOps & Cloud: Linux, Docker, AWS, Grafana

What we are looking for

Required:

  • Education: MSc or PhD in Computer Science, Robotics, Electrical or Mechanical Engineering, or similar.

  • Python: This is a must. You write clean Python that runs in production, on real systems.

  • Embedded & Hardware: Shipped C/C++ on microcontrollers running on physical hardware; comfortable working with sensors, actuators, and basic electronics.

  • Applied AI & Control: Understanding of modern control and ML/RL methods, with hands-on PyTorch experience applied to physical or dynamic systems.

  • Cloud & data: You are comfortable with PostgreSQL, Docker and AWS.

  • Leadership attitude: You take ownership, make decisions, and want to grow as a leader.

  • Languages: English. German is a big plus.

  • Hybrid setting: You will be expected to be on-site at least three days per week, and sometimes at customers’ locations, to work on real products.

  • Availability: 100%, as soon as possible.

  • Work-permit: You need the right to work in Switzerland for this position.

Preferred:

  • Startup experience: You have worked in a startup before and know what that means.

  • Building modeling and control: You have prior experience handling building data, modeling building dynamics, and developing building controllers; ideally with ML and RL tools.

  • Frontend: React and TypeScript.

Mindset:

  • Hands-on: You lead, and you still do the hard work yourself.

  • Fast: You are pragmatic and iterate quickly. Things break, and plans change, and that doesn't scare you.

  • Purpose: You care about climate and want to make buildings smarter.

Benefits

Impact: Your code runs on real buildings. You see the result of your work.

Ownership: A key role with a real say in our product and technology, and room to grow with the company.

Flexibility: Hybrid work and flexible hours. We like being in the Zurich office together, so plan for regular office days.

Team: A small, skilled, and down-to-earth team that helps each other out.

The reality: We are a startup. It is often messy; things rarely work the first time, and the workload is real. In return, you get a lot of freedom and responsibility from day one.

Sounds like you?

Send us your CV and a short document instead of a classic cover letter. It doesn’t need to be long, just enough for us to understand who you are and where you stand. Please cover these points:

  • About you: A short description of yourself.

  • Proud of: One thing you are really proud of, in a few sentences.

  • Startup: Why do you fit a startup?

  • Software meets hardware: Your experience where software and hardware come together.

  • Juggeling many hats: You’ll rarely finish one thing from A to Z without interruptions: different stacks, different people, different projects, and on-site surprises. Describe a time your work was like that, and how you handled it.

Job Description

TITLE: Philanthropic Services Manager

REPORTS TO: Senior Director of Philanthropic Services

STATUS: Regular, Full-time, Non-Exempt

POSITION DESCRIPTION: This position manages processes related to contributions into the Community Foundation’s charitable funds, which includes entering and maintaining records in the constituent record management (CRM) database and collaborating with staff in other departments to ensure timely and accurate contribution acknowledgment. The manager ensures efficient operations, accurate documentation and a positive experience for donors through responsive, high-level customer service.


The Philanthropic Services Manager also supports fund administration and data management as a member of the philanthropic services team within the philanthropy department, managing workflows for new fund development and capturing prospect and donor information in the CRM database for current and future stewardship. This position requires both familiarity with database logic and reporting, and an ability to interact via phone and email with clients in a professional and responsive manner.

    • Manage communication preferences for constituents in order to produce accurate email and mailing lists for Foundation communications.
    • Research key constituencies (professional advisors, current and potential donors and board members, etc.) and capture pertinent information in CRM in support of relationship building efforts.

  • Reporting and Operational Support
    • Analyze data and prepare reports for internal and external audiences, consistent with Foundation policies.

    • Complete ongoing data maintenance and clean-up projects.

  • Donor Relations

    • Address general inquiries related to philanthropy department functions and support development work as needed.

  • Other Duties. Other duties and projects as assigned to further the Foundation's mission and goals.

  • An ongoing commitment to training in both soft skills and technical skills in the spirit of continual learning and improvement.

TIME REQUIREMENT: This is a full-time, non-exempt position requiring 37.5 hours per week. Work hours are 8:30 a.m. to 4:30 p.m. with some flexibility in a hybrid work schedule; availability to attend occasional evening events. Tuesdays through Thursdays are designated in-office days. Staff that choose to work a hybrid work schedule may choose to do so on Mondays and/or Fridays, dependent on approval.

SALARY & BENEFITS: Salary range: $55,000 to $62,000. Employee benefits include health insurance, annual vacation and sick & safe leave, twelve paid holidays, term life insurance, additional disability insurance, parking, 401(k) retirement savings program with employer contribution and match, optional flex spending accounts for medical or dependent care expenses and other benefits as outlined in the employee handbook.

title: AI Automation Engineer
description:

Role Overview

The AI Automation Engineer will design, build, deploy, and maintain AI-powered internal tools that automate research, buyer evaluation, briefing preparation, and other business workflows.

Location

title: Senior User Researcher
description:
Property Finder is the leading property portal in the Middle East and North Africa (MENA) region, dedicated to shaping an inclusive future for real estate while spearheading the region’s growing tech ecosystem. At its core is a clear and powerful purpose: To change living for good in the region.


Founded on the value of great ambitions, Property Finder connects millions of property seekers with thousands of real estate professionals every day. Since its inception in 2007, Property Finder has evolved into a trusted partner for developers, brokers, and home seekers. As a lighthouse tech company, it continues to create an environment where people can thrive and contribute meaningfully to the transformation of real estate in MENA.


Position Summary



As Property Finder grows in Egypt, understanding local consumer behaviour, customer needs and market dynamics is critical to building the right products and driving business growth.


You will lead research across property seekers, real estate agents and developers, translating insights into product improvements, roadmap priorities and business decisions.


This is a hands-on role for an experienced researcher who can independently deliver research projects, work effectively with Product and Design, and communicate insights clearly in both Arabic and English.


Key Responsibilities


  • Lead end-to-end research, from defining questions and selecting research methods to delivering actionable insights and recommendations.


  • Partner with Product and Design to identify user needs, prioritise opportunities and shape the Egypt product roadmap.


  • Conduct discovery research, concept testing, usability testing and post-launch evaluation. Investigate consumer behaviour, local market dynamics and competitive opportunities to inform product and business strategy.


  • Apply qualitative and quantitative methods, combining research findings with analytics and customer feedback to validate hypotheses.


  • Communicate findings through clear evidence-based recommendations that influence decisions across teams.


  • Maintain consistent research standards, document findings and ensure insights are accessible and used across the business.



Desired Qualifications


  • 6+ years of user research experience in technology, digital marketplaces or other product-led businesses.


  • Experience in the Egyptian market, with a strong understanding of local consumer behaviour and the real estate sector.


  • Proven experience independently running end-to-end research projects and managing multiple priorities.


  • Strong qualitative and quantitative research skills, including interviews, usability testing, concept testing and survey design.


  • Proven experience influencing product decisions and business outcomes through actionable research insights.


  • Experience conducting research with Arabic and English speaking participants.


  • A proactive, hands-on approach, with the confidence to challenge assumptions and work independently.


  • Familiarity with research and analytics tools such as Qualtrics, Maze, Microsoft Clarity, Metabase and Dovetail.


Other Capabilities


  • Experience in real estate, property marketplaces or two-sided digital marketplaces.


  • Experience researching both B2C and B2B audiences.


  • Experience with advanced quantitative methods, such as MaxDiff or conjoint analysis.



Our promise to talent

At Property Finder, we believe talent thrives in an environment where you can be your best self. Where you are empowered to create, elevate, grow, and care. Our team is made up of the best and brightest, united by a shared ambition to change living for good in the region. We attract top talent who want to make an impact. We firmly believe that when our people grow, we all succeed.

title: Clinical Health Assistant
description:
Job Description: SEM Clinical Health Assistant (CHA)

Schedule: Monday - Friday 8:30-5:00 pm


The MacEwan University Health Centre is a new state-of-the-art primary care clinic, located in downtown Edmonton, focused on the Patient-Centered Medical Home model which provides patient-centered, comprehensive, coordinated, and accessible care based on the patient’s needs. MUHC’s unique academic teaching, medical home model of health care provides a friendly, supportive, caring and learning environment. Along with supporting work-life balance and a positive team environment, we empower our staff to enhance their skills, to foster growth and development with educational opportunities.

Reporting to the CHA Supervisor, the Clinical Health Assistant (CHA) is typically the first point of clinical contact for patients and is responsible for providing care and support to patients in the clinical environment, as well as helping them navigate community resources. Similar to that of a Medical Office Assistant, the Clinical Health Assistant (CHA) features an exciting expanded scope aspect to this role as a non-physician practitioner which allows for more training and educational opportunities. The Clinical Health Assistant works collaboratively with other CHAs, their supervisor and a physician lead to manage an assigned panel of patients. This will be a demanding, challenging, and rewarding role within the clinic.


Duties and Responsibilities


Direct Patient Care and Procedure Support

  • Greet and room patients, obtain vital signs, update patient information and collect focused histories as directed by the clinical team.
  • Review routine screening needs and prepare requisitions or follow-up tasks according to clinic protocols and clinician direction.
  • Assist with minor procedures, including platelet-rich plasma (PRP) and other injections; prepare rooms, equipment, supplies and sterile trays as required.
  • Provide hands-on assistance during appointments and procedures as directed, maintain patient comfort and dignity, and act as a chaperone for sensitive examinations.
  • Assist with specimen collection and initial blood and urine screening, and perform electrocardiograms and phlebotomy when appropriately trained and authorized.
  • Prepare ultrasound equipment for use and complete cleaning and care of equipment according to clinic procedures.
  • Ensure required consent documentation is available and completed through the approved clinic process.
  • Recognize and promptly escalate concerning symptoms or critical red flags, including suspected acute fractures, to the appropriate clinician.
  • Provide clinician-approved post-visit summaries, procedure-specific pamphlets and aftercare instructions.



Referral and Appointment Coordination



  • Receive, screen for administrative completeness, track and coordinate sports medicine referrals, seeking clinical review when urgency or suitability requires a decision.
  • Use clinic-approved referral pathways and electronic systems, including Connect Care where access is authorized, to support referral processing and tracking.
  • Maintain referral tracking lists and follow up on missed appointments or incomplete referral steps.
  • Assist clinicians with urgent orthopaedic referrals and urgent MRI coordination using approved processes.
  • Coordinate PRP and other injection appointments, including timing, clinician availability and procedure requirements.
  • Coordinate appointments for out-of-town patients to support timely access and reduce unnecessary travel where possible.
  • Create and update patient profiles for off-site services, enter clinician-provided instructions into the clinical schedule, maintain relevant service rosters and arrange follow-up appointments at MUHC.



Documentation and Team Coordination

  • Maintain accurate and timely electronic medical records and communicate with patients by telephone or through approved channels in response to team requests.
  • Prepare patient charts and schedules for upcoming appointments and participate in morning huddles with nurses, physicians and residents.
  • Format clinician-provided consultation and visit notes into standardized letters; review spelling, formatting and medical terminology, and return documents to the clinician for approval.
  • Work with the team nurse and physicians to follow up on outstanding tasks, investigations and consultations as directed.
  • Support billing administration for assigned physicians, including additional physician coverage where assigned, according to approved clinic processes.
  • Organize group visits, including patient notification, materials, staffing and logistics.
  • Protect patient confidentiality and use only approved systems for patient information and communication.
  • Clinic and Equipment Support
  • Clean and stock examination and procedure rooms, prepare supply lists and monitor procedure supplies.
  • Clean computers, monitors and examination-room surfaces according to clinic procedures.
  • Clean and sterilize surgical instruments and equipment according to established infection prevention procedures.
  • Maintain readiness of clinical equipment and report equipment or supply concerns promptly.


Qualifications

  • Medical Office Assistant diploma/certification
  • Criminal Record and Vulnerable Sector check
  • 2+ years’ medical office experience, Primary Care experience considered an asset
  • EMR experience an asset
  • Proficient with Microsoft Office applications
  • Excellent communication and time management skills
  • Willing to train for expanded scope practices such as Phlebotomies, ECG’s, etc.
  • Professional and friendly manner
  • Enthusiastic and thrives in a fast paced and changing environment
  • Applicants in consideration will be required to adhere to a criminal record search.



We provide competitive compensation, professional development, and a full benefits package:


  • Medical/Dental/Vision
  • Maternity Leave
  • Parental Leave
  • Paid Holidays
  • Vacation/Paid Sick Leave
  • RRSP


Applicants in consideration will be required to adhere to a criminal record search. We thank you for your interest, however, only qualified applicants will be contacted. Out-of-province/country applications will not be considered.

title: Part-Time Juvenile Case Manager/JP 2 Clerk
description:
JUVENILE CASE MANAGER / JP2 CLERK — PART-TIME
Department: Burnet County Justice of the Peace, Precinct 2 Reports To: Justice of the Peace
Works Under the Direction of: Justice of the Peace and Chief Clerk


The Juvenile Case Manager / JP2 Clerk provides case management, administrative, and clerical
support for the Burnet County Justice of the Peace, Precinct 2 Court, with primary responsibilities
involving Truancy and Juvenile Diversion. The position works closely with Burnet CISD
schools, students, parents, the Burnet County Attorney’s Office, and community resources
to monitor attendance, coordinate truancy referrals, prepare and maintain cases, monitor
compliance, and assist with court proceedings. The position also performs JP2 Clerk duties,
including processing citations, complaints, petitions, payments, and court records; assisting the
public; and providing general support to the Court. Duties are performed with confidentiality,
professionalism, accuracy, and independent judgment under the direction of the Justice of the Peace and Chief Clerk.


ESSENTIAL RESPONSIBILITIES AND DUTIES
1. Work closely with Burnet CISD schools, school officials, students, and parents to address and
prevent truancy and improve school attendance.
2. Develop, implement, and monitor Truancy Prevention Plans and other appropriate
interventions for students referred to the program.
3. Monitor student attendance through available school attendance systems, including
Skyward, and maintain communication with school officials regarding attendance,
compliance, and student progress.
4. Conduct school visits and, when appropriate and authorized, home visits to meet with students
and/or parents regarding attendance, compliance, available resources, and barriers to
regular school attendance.
5. Work with schools, students, parents, and community organizations to identify and
coordinate educational, family, transportation, social service, and other available
resources that may assist students in successfully attending school and complying with program or
court requirements.
6. Receive truancy referrals from Burnet CISD schools; forward appropriate cases to
the Burnet County Attorney’s Office for prosecutorial review.
7. Upon approval by the prosecutor, complete the truancy intake process, enter cases into
Odyssey, scan and upload documentation, and create and maintain accurate electronic
and/or physical case files.

8. Prepare petitions, complaints, motions, orders, notices, and other documents necessary
for the processing and management of truancy cases.

9. Schedule, coordinate, prepare for, and attend Truancy Court hearings and
other proceedings involving truant conduct cases.
10. Monitor all active Truant Conduct and Juvenile Diversion cases for compliance with court
orders, diversion agreements, attendance requirements, deadlines, and other conditions.

11. Assist with the intake, processing, documentation, and monitoring of Juvenile Diversion
cases handled by the Justice Court.
12. Enter and maintain citations, complaints, petitions, case notes, compliance information, and
other case-related information in Odyssey and other applicable systems.
13. Document communications and case activity, including telephone calls, emails, office
visits, school contacts, meetings, compliance updates, and other relevant interactions
involving Truancy and Juvenile Diversion cases.
14. Provide general clerical and administrative support to the Justice of the Peace, Precinct 2
office as needed.
15. Process traffic and other Justice Court citations by accurately entering case information into
Odyssey, scanning and uploading citations and supporting documents, and
maintaining court records.
16. Assist members of the public in person, by telephone, and through
electronic communication regarding court procedures, case information, payment options, required
forms, and other matters within the authority of the Clerk's office.
17. Serve as a liaison between defendants, attorneys, school officials, parents, students, the
public, and the Court while maintaining judicial neutrality and appropriate professional
boundaries.

18. Receive and process court payments; accurately issue receipts and maintain appropriate
financial records in accordance with office procedures.
19. Assist with preparation of daily financial transactions and deposits and deliver deposits
and related documentation to the Burnet County Treasurer's Office as required.
20. Attend and assist with court proceedings as directed by the Justice of the Peace or Chief
Clerk.
21. Maintain the confidentiality of juvenile records, court information, and other confidential
or sensitive information encountered in the performance of assigned duties.
22. Exercise sound independent judgment when handling routine matters and refer legal
questions, unusual circumstances, policy issues, and administrative concerns to the
Justice of the Peace or Chief Clerk as appropriate.
23. Maintain professional conduct consistent with the integrity and impartiality of the
judiciary and observe applicable ethical standards, including standards applicable to court
personnel and the principles expressed in the Texas Code of Judicial Conduct.
24. Maintain regular and punctual attendance and perform assigned duties reliably and
efficiently.
25. Perform other related duties as assigned by the Justice of the Peace or Chief Clerk.

title: Project Director (Hospitality & Theme Park)
description:
Job DescriptionOverview

We are seeking an exceptional Project Director to lead the Project Management Consultancy (PMCM) team on a significant theme park, waterpark and destination development. The Project Director will provide strategic leadership and overall responsibility for project delivery throughout design management, procurement, construction, testing & commissioning, opening, handover and defects liability phases. Acting as the primary point of accountability to the Client, the successful candidate will drive achievement of project objectives related to schedule, cost, quality, safety, sustainability and stakeholder management while leading a multi-disciplinary team of project controls, commercial, planning, design, HSE, QA/QC and construction management professionals, and managing the interfaces with the operator, ride and attraction vendors and specialist contractors.


Your roleProject Leadership & Client Representation

  • Lead and manage the PMC and Supervision team throughout the project lifecycle.
  • Maintain full alignment with the Client's vision, governance framework and development objectives.

We are seeking an IT Service Desk Specialist to provide first-line service desk support for enterprise end users, supporting Vodafone Automotive and Global Catalogue users through a helpdesk-to-helpdesk support model. The role covers request management, incident management, authorisation management, service level management, relationship management, problem management and inventory-related support, while coordinating with internal teams, partners, affiliates and third-party suppliers to deliver timely, quality-focused resolutions.

This role is based in Cairo and sits within the Enterprise function, supporting service desk operations for Vodafone Automotive, a Vodafone Group entity delivering automotive products and services to multinational customers and their end users.


What you’ll do


  • Receive and manage requests and incidents through channels such as M2M, Remedy, VGECO, ServiceNow, email, phone and other integrated portals, with a strong focus on call-based support.

  • Take ownership of incidents, escalations, orders and tickets, including follow-up activities and liaison with partners until resolution.

  • Liaise with internal and external partners, including OPAs, Service Managers and Account Managers, to support effective service delivery.

You may be the right candidate for this or another opportunity, and the recruitment team will support you in exploring where your skills fit best.




What's in it for you


  • An opportunity to support multinational Vodafone Automotive customers and enterprise end users in a global service environment.

  • Exposure to a broad service desk model covering incident management, request management, authorisation management, service level management, knowledge management and problem management.

What skills you will learn

  • SLA monitoring, escalation follow-up and partner coordination across internal and external support teams.

  • Knowledge management practices, including FAQ creation, support collateral maintenance and contact list management.

What do our Auto Body Technicians do?


SUMMARY:

The Auto Body Technician is responsible for repairing damaged vehicle body parts in accordance with company specifications, processes and time standards. The Auto Body Technician is skilled in analyzing, assessing and fixing damaged vehicles. This role is responsible for repairing, replacing and refinishing outer body parts. This position will also be skilled in fixing internal automotive structures.


ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS AND RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Repairs vehicles per estimate and according to established standards. This position prepares vehicles for body repair work. Additionally, the Auto Body Technician will be challenged with restoring bodywork to its original condition. This may include removing damaged parts and installing replacement parts utilizing specialized tools to repair the damage and realign structural components.
  • Communicates with management regarding any additional repairs that may be needed on a customer’s vehicle. Notifies management of any difficulties or problems that may prevent a quality job from being performed or cause a change in the promised completion/delivery time.
  • Maintains tools and equipment in good working order. Operates all tools and equipment in a safe manner. Ensures that work area is organized, clean and free of safety hazards.
  • Maintains and wears all required safety and health personal protective equipment, including eye protection.
  • Cooperates and assists other personnel in the repair and prepping of vehicles, often dependent upon schedule and area of expertise.
  • Understands, keeps abreast of and complies with federal, state and local regulations that affect body shop operations, such as hazardous waste disposal.


QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Solid working knowledge of the processes, techniques and materials used in repairing automotive equipment with a minimum of 1-3 years of experience working in the collision repair arena.
