title: QMHP A/T/C
description:
Position Title: Qualified Mental Health Professional (QMHP)
Department: Behavioral Health Services
Reports To: Program Director / Clinical Supervisor
Employment Status: Full-Time / Part-Time / PRN
Location: Community-Based / Office-Based as assigned

Position Summary

The Qualified Mental Health Professional (QMHP) provides person-centered behavioral health services to individuals experiencing mental health, emotional, behavioral, and functional challenges. The QMHP works under appropriate clinical supervision and provides services within the individual's authorized service plan, agency policies, payer requirements, and applicable Virginia regulations.

The QMHP assists individuals with symptom management, crisis prevention, development of coping skills, independent living skills, treatment adherence, community integration, and linkage to behavioral health and community resources.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

The QMHP will:

  • Provide behavioral health interventions consistent with the individual's assessment, ISP, and identified treatment goals.
  • Conduct ongoing assessment of the individual's functioning, symptoms, strengths, needs, risks, and progress.
  • Assist individuals in identifying triggers, warning signs, and symptoms associated with psychiatric deterioration.
  • Teach and reinforce coping skills, emotional-regulation techniques, problem-solving skills, and crisis-prevention strategies.
  • Provide skill-building interventions addressing daily living, community functioning, medication-management skills, appointment adherence, and use of community resources when applicable to the service.
  • Monitor for changes in mental status, suicidal ideation, homicidal ideation, self-harm risk, substance use, or other significant safety concerns.
  • Implement and review individualized safety and crisis plans.
  • Immediately follow agency emergency procedures when an individual presents an imminent danger to self or others.
  • Coordinate care with LMHPs, physicians, psychiatric providers, hospitals, CSBs, case managers, outpatient providers, and other treatment professionals when authorized and clinically appropriate.
  • Assist individuals with accessing medical, psychiatric, housing, transportation, benefits, employment, and other community resources.
  • Participate in discharge and transition planning to promote continuity of care and prevent unnecessary hospitalization or recurrence of crisis.
  • Maintain professional boundaries and protect individual confidentiality in accordance with HIPAA and agency requirements.

Documentation Responsibilities

The QMHP is responsible for completing accurate, individualized, and timely clinical documentation, including:

  • Progress/BIRP notes
  • Service-plan documentation
  • Safety-plan documentation
  • Crisis/risk assessments as applicable
  • Care-coordination documentation
  • Discharge and transition documentation
  • Incident documentation
  • Other clinical records required by Changing Lives Family Care, LLC or the applicable payer/service

Documentation must accurately reflect the individual's presentation, interventions actually provided, response to intervention, progress or lack of progress, and plan for continued treatment.

Crisis and Safety Responsibilities

The QMHP will recognize and appropriately respond to behavioral health emergencies. Responsibilities include assessing observable changes in risk, notifying the appropriate clinical supervisor or LMHP, implementing established safety procedures, and facilitating access to emergency/crisis services when clinically indicated.

The QMHP must immediately report suspected abuse, neglect, exploitation, serious incidents, or other reportable events according to agency policy and applicable requirements.

Minimum Qualifications

The employee must meet the applicable Virginia QMHP qualification and registration requirements for the population and service being provided and maintain all required credentials throughout employment.

The employee must also:

  • Successfully complete required background checks.
  • Maintain current CPR/First Aid certification when required by the program.
  • Complete orientation and mandatory annual training.
  • Maintain required continuing education and credentialing documentation.
  • Demonstrate competency in behavioral health documentation, crisis response, professional boundaries, confidentiality, and person-centered services.
  • Possess effective written and verbal communication skills.
  • Be able to work independently in community settings while following clinical supervision requirements.

Knowledge and Skills

The QMHP should demonstrate knowledge of mental health disorders, crisis intervention, suicide-risk awareness, trauma-informed care, person-centered planning, de-escalation, community resources, cultural responsiveness, and professional ethics.

Performance Expectations

The QMHP is expected to maintain complete and timely records, attend required supervision and staff meetings, maintain assigned caseload responsibilities, comply with authorization limitations, and provide only services that are medically necessary and actually delivered.

Falsification, duplication, backdating, or documentation of services not provided is prohibited.

Confidentiality

All individual information must be maintained in strict confidence. The QMHP must comply with HIPAA, agency confidentiality policies, individual-rights requirements, and applicable federal and state privacy standards.

title: Parts Department Lead
description:
Department: Parts / Shipping & Receiving
Reports To: Supply Chain Manager
FLSA Status: Non-Exempt
Location: Coastline Power Solutions – DeLand, Florida


Position Summary

The Parts Department Team Lead is responsible for overseeing the daily operation of the parts cage and shipping and receiving areas. This position leads the employees assigned to these functions and ensures that materials, parts, equipment, and customer supplied equipment & generators are received, stored, issued, loaded, and shipped safely and accurately.

The Team Lead maintains inventory organization and accountability, coordinates incoming and outgoing shipments, supports production material needs, and ensures generators and other large equipment are loaded and unloaded using proper equipment and safe material-handling practices.


Essential Duties and Responsibilities

Leadership and Daily Operations

  • Lead, direct, and support employees assigned to the parts cage and shipping and receiving functions.
  • Assign daily work responsibilities and establish priorities based on production and shipping requirements.
  • Monitor employee performance, productivity, attendance, safety practices, and quality of work.
  • Train employees on inventory procedures, material handling, shipping requirements, equipment operation, and departmental processes.
  • Communicate staffing, inventory, quality, safety, and scheduling concerns to management.
  • Promote teamwork, accountability, professionalism, and good housekeeping throughout the department.
  • Assist management with employee coaching, performance feedback, and corrective action when necessary.


Parts Cage and Inventory Control

  • Oversee the receipt, identification, labeling, storage, and issuance of parts and materials.
  • Ensure inventory is stored in the correct location and protected from damage, loss, or deterioration.
  • Maintain an organized, secure, and accurate parts cage.
  • Verify that parts issued to production are properly documented and charged to the correct project, job, or department.
  • Monitor minimum and maximum inventory levels and communicate shortages or discrepancies to Purchasing and Production.
  • Conduct cycle counts and assist with physical inventory counts.
  • Investigate and help resolve inventory discrepancies.
  • Coordinate the return of unused, damaged, incorrect, or excess materials.
  • Ensure materials are handled in accordance with any applicable shelf-life, environmental, or storage requirements.


Shipping and Receiving

  • Coordinate and oversee incoming and outgoing shipments.
  • Unload trucks and verify received materials against purchase orders, packing slips, bills of lading, and other receiving documents.
  • Inspect incoming materials for quantity, visible damage, and general condition.
  • Document shortages, overages, incorrect items, and freight damage and promptly communicate issues to the appropriate department.
  • Prepare parts, materials, equipment, and customer supplied equipment for shipment.
  • Verify that outgoing shipments are complete, properly packaged, labeled, secured, and documented.
  • Complete or review shipping documents, packing lists, bills of lading, and freight paperwork.
  • Coordinate pickup and delivery schedules with carriers, vendors, project managers, production personnel, and customers as needed.
  • Maintain organized receiving and staging areas to prevent misplaced or damaged materials.


Generator and Material Handling

  • Safely unload incoming generators and load completed generators for shipment.
  • Ensure loads are properly positioned, balanced, blocked, braced, and secured.
  • Work with spotters and other employees when moving oversized, heavy, or restricted-visibility loads.
  • Stop work and report any unsafe condition, damaged lifting equipment, unstable load, or equipment concern.


Safety and Compliance

  • Enforce company safety policies, shipping requirements, and material-handling procedures.
  • Ensure required pre-use inspections are completed for forklifts, lifting devices, and other assigned equipment.
  • Verify that only trained and authorized employees operate powered industrial trucks or lifting equipment.
  • Maintain clear aisles, exits, loading areas, fire equipment access, and pedestrian walkways.
  • Ensure employees use required personal protective equipment.
  • Report injuries, incidents, near misses, product damage, and property damage immediately.
  • Participate in safety meetings, incident investigations, corrective actions, and departmental inspections.
  • Maintain shipping, receiving, inspection, and inventory records according to company procedures.


Supervisory Responsibilities

This position provides daily leadership and work direction to employees assigned to the parts cage and shipping and receiving areas. Responsibilities may include:

  • Assigning and monitoring daily work.
  • Training and cross-training employees.
  • Reviewing work for accuracy and completion.
  • Providing performance feedback.
  • Enforcing safety and departmental procedures.
  • Escalating disciplinary, attendance, staffing, or performance concerns to management.
  • Supporting interviews and onboarding for departmental employees when requested.


Required Qualifications

  • High school diploma or GED.
  • At least three years of experience in shipping, receiving, warehousing, inventory control, material handling, or a related manufacturing environment.
  • Previous team lead, supervisory, or demonstrated leadership experience.
  • Experience operating forklifts and other material-handling equipment.
  • Ability to read and understand purchase orders, packing slips, bills of lading, shipping documents, part numbers, and inventory records.
  • Basic computer skills, including experience entering and retrieving inventory or shipping information.
  • Strong organizational, communication, problem-solving, and time-management skills.
  • Ability to safely coordinate the movement of large, heavy, and oversized equipment.


Preferred Qualifications

  • Five or more years of shipping, receiving, warehouse, or inventory-control experience in a manufacturing environment.
  • Experience loading and unloading generators, industrial equipment, or other oversized products.
  • Experience with ERP, MRP, warehouse-management, or inventory-control software.
  • Knowledge of freight classification, carrier coordination, load securement, and shipping documentation.
  • Forklift certification or the ability to complete company-required certification.
  • Previous experience leading employees in a fast-paced production environment.


Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

  • Ability to lead employees while maintaining positive working relationships.
  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to inventory accuracy.
  • Ability to plan work, establish priorities, and respond to changing production demands.
  • Ability to communicate effectively with Production, Purchasing, Engineering, Project Management, Quality, and outside carriers.
  • Ability to identify material damage, shipping discrepancies, and unsafe conditions.
  • Ability to maintain accurate records and follow established procedures.
  • Sound judgment when moving large or heavy loads.
  • Ability to remain professional and productive under time-sensitive shipping requirements.


Physical Requirements

  • Ability to regularly stand, walk, bend, reach, climb, kneel, and work in and around warehouse and production areas.
  • Ability to lift and carry up to 50 pounds independently and heavier items with appropriate assistance or lifting equipment.
  • Ability to enter and exit forklifts and other material-handling equipment.
  • Ability to work around moving equipment, trucks, trailers, generators, uneven surfaces, and changing weather conditions.
  • Ability to visually inspect parts, shipping labels, documents, and loads.
  • Ability to wear required personal protective equipment.


Work Environment

This position works primarily in a manufacturing, warehouse, and outdoor yard environment. The employee may be exposed to heat, cold, rain, noise, dust, vehicle traffic, moving equipment, suspended loads, and other normal industrial conditions.


Performance Expectations

Success in this position will be measured by:

  • Inventory accuracy and parts accountability.
  • Timely receiving and availability of materials for production.
  • Accurate and on-time outgoing shipments.
  • Safe loading and unloading of generators and materials.
  • Cleanliness and organization of the parts cage and shipping areas.
  • Reduction of freight damage, misplaced materials, and shipping errors.
  • Employee productivity, training, teamwork, and compliance with safety procedures.
  • Clear communication with internal departments, carriers, vendors, and management.

title: MEP Coordinator
description:
What You Can Expect at CMC Design Build

At CMC DESIGN BUILD, we value diverse perspectives and welcome candidates whose experience may look different from the traditional path. If you can bring value, we want to hear from you.

Why CMC?

With 37+ years of experience designing and building food and beverage processing and distribution facilities nationwide, CMC offers the opportunity to work alongside leading companies including HP Hood, Coca-Cola, Amazon, Cumberland Farms, Daniele Foods, and Blount Fine Foods.

At CMC, you’ll have direct access to clients, industry experts, and opportunities to:

  • Grow your expertise and take on new challenges
  • Build a career without having to leave the company
  • Work independently in a results-driven environment
  • Bring your ideas and perspective to the table
  • Enjoy competitive benefits supporting your health, financial security, and life beyond work

We’re looking for energetic, talented professionals who speak up, listen well, collaborate, and step beyond their role to make an impact. You’ll thrive here if you’re driven to get things done, see obstacles as opportunities, and take pride in delivering great work.


If you’re looking for an entrepreneurial environment where you can grow, make an impact, and enjoy the journey, CMC DESIGN BUILD could be the right fit for you.

Join us as an MEP Coordinator!

We are seeking a highly skilled MEP (Mechanical, Electrical, Plumbing) Coordinator with specialized experience in cold storage, food, and beverage industries for our dynamic design-build team. As the MEP Coordinator, you will play a pivotal role in the successful execution of projects, ensuring seamless integration of mechanical, electrical, and plumbing systems within cold storage facilities, food processing plants, and beverage production facilities. Your expertise will be instrumental in maintaining high-quality standards, adherence to industry regulations, and client satisfaction.

.

Some of your key responsibilities include:

  • Project Coordination: Collaborate with project managers, architects, engineers, subcontractors, and clients to develop comprehensive MEP plans, specifications, and models for cold storage, food, and beverage projects.
  • Design Review: Conduct thorough reviews of mechanical, electrical, and plumbing designs to ensure compliance with industry standards, client requirements, and project specifications.
  • Value Engineering: Identify opportunities for value engineering to optimize MEP systems performance, minimize costs, and enhance energy efficiency while maintaining project objectives.
  • Procurement Assistance: Assist in the procurement process by providing technical expertise in selecting MEP equipment, materials, and systems, ensuring compatibility and compliance with project requirements.
  • Subcontractor Management: Oversee MEP subcontractors throughout the construction phase, providing guidance, resolving technical issues, and ensuring adherence to project schedules and quality standards.
  • Quality Control: Implement rigorous quality control measures to verify the installation and functionality of MEP systems, conducting inspections, tests, and commissioning procedures.
  • Regulatory Compliance: Stay abreast of relevant building codes, regulations, and industry standards pertaining to MEP systems in cold storage, food, and beverage facilities, ensuring full compliance throughout the project lifecycle.
  • Risk Management: Identify potential risks and challenges related to MEP systems integration and propose effective mitigation strategies to minimize project disruptions and ensure timely delivery.
  • Client Liaison: Act as the primary point of contact for MEP-related inquiries, providing regular updates, addressing concerns, and fostering positive client relationships.
  • Continuous Improvement: Proactively seek opportunities to enhance MEP coordination processes, methodologies, and best practices to drive efficiency, innovation, and excellence in project delivery.

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in Mechanical, Electrical, or Plumbing Engineering, or related field. Master's degree preferred but not required.
  • Minimum of 5 years of experience in MEP coordination, preferably within the design-build environment, with a focus on cold storage, food, and beverage, advanced manufacturing, pharma, or healthcare projects.
  • In-depth knowledge of MEP systems design, installation, and integration principles, with a strong understanding of industry-specific requirements and challenges.
  • Proficiency in CAD and Revit for BIM coordination and clash detection.
  • Excellent communication, collaboration, and leadership skills, with the ability to effectively engage with multidisciplinary teams, subcontractors, and clients.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities, with a keen attention to detail and a proactive approach to resolving technical issues.
  • Professional Engineer (PE) license is beneficial but not required.

title: Project Manager
description:
Position Summary

Job title: Project Manager

Department: Projects / Operations

Location: Project sites, Kingdom of Saudi Arabia (wind farm and power project locations)

Reports to: Project Director

Nationality: Saudi National

Experience: Minimum 3 years in project management on wind or major power projects

Employment type: Full-time, site-based with travel between project locations


Role Purpose

The Project Manager delivers assigned wind and power projects safely, on schedule, within budget and to contract requirements. The role leads site teams, manages client and subcontractor relationships, and controls the commercial, operational and HSE performance of the project from mobilization to handover.


Key Responsibilities


Project Planning and Execution

  • Lead project delivery from mobilization through execution, demobilization and close-out.
  • Prepare and maintain project execution plans, schedules, resource plans and method statements.
  • Plan and coordinate heavy lifting and installation activities (e.g. WTG components, transformers, structural steel) with site and engineering teams.
  • Monitor daily progress against baseline and take corrective action on delays.
  • Ensure equipment, cranes and manpower are mobilized and utilized efficiently.


Client and Stakeholder Management

  • Act as the main point of contact for the client, EPC contractor and consultants on site.
  • Attend and lead progress meetings; issue weekly and monthly progress reports.
  • Manage correspondence, variations, claims and change requests in line with the contract.
  • Liaise with government entities, local authorities and Saudi stakeholders for permits and approvals.


Commercial and Contract Management

  • Control project budget, costs and cash flow; report forecasts and variances.
  • Review and administer client contracts, subcontracts and purchase orders.
  • Verify subcontractor and vendor timesheets, invoices and payment applications.
  • Support procurement of equipment, services and materials with the procurement team.
  • Prepare monthly client invoices and supporting documentation.


Health, Safety, Environment and Quality

  • Promote a strong safety culture and enforce company and client HSE requirements.
  • Ensure lifting plans, risk assessments, permits to work and toolbox talks are in place.
  • Lead incident reporting, investigations and close-out of corrective actions.
  • Ensure work complies with the project quality plan, ITPs and applicable Saudi regulations.


People and Team Leadership

  • Lead, motivate and develop site managers, supervisors, operators and support staff.
  • Plan manpower requirements, rotations and mobilization with HR.
  • Develop Saudi talent through coaching, mentoring and on-the-job training.
  • Conduct performance reviews and resolve site-level people issues.


Reporting and Documentation

  • Maintain complete project records: daily reports, equipment and manpower logs, and handover files.
  • Track KPIs and report project performance to the Project Director and senior management.
  • Capture lessons learned and support continuous improvement of company procedures.





Skills

Education

  • Bachelor's degree in Mechanical, Electrical, Civil or Industrial Engineering, or a related field.
  • PMP, PRINCE2 or equivalent project management certification is preferred.
  • Saudi Council of Engineers (SCE) membership is an advantage.


Experience

  • Minimum 3 years of project management experience on onshore wind, solar, substation, transmission or other major power projects.
  • Hands-on exposure to heavy lifting, crane operations or WTG installation is highly preferred.
  • Experience working with international EPC contractors and OEMs (e.g. wind turbine manufacturers).
  • Proven record of managing site teams, subcontractors and project budgets.


Technical Skills

  • Project scheduling and control using Primavera P6 or MS Project.
  • Strong knowledge of contract administration, variations and claims.
  • Understanding of lifting plans, rigging, HSE standards and permit-to-work systems.
  • Proficient in MS Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint) and project reporting tools.

Core Competencies

  • Leadership and team management in a multicultural site environment.
  • Clear communication and negotiation with clients, vendors and authorities.
  • Commercial awareness, cost control and problem solving.
  • Ability to work under pressure in remote site conditions and meet tight deadlines.


Other Requirements

  • Saudi National.
  • Fluent in Arabic and English.
  • Valid Saudi driving license.
  • Willing to be based on site and travel between project locations.


Working Conditions

  • Site-based role at remote wind and power project locations in KSA.
  • Exposure to outdoor conditions, heights and heavy lifting operations.
  • Rotation and working hours as per company policy and project needs.

title: Shelter Coordinator- 2nd Shift
description:
The main mission of the City Rescue Mission of Lansing, since its founding, has remained to teach the Word of God as found in the Christian Bible (Romans 10:13-15), edify and equip the saints to be committed followers of Jesus Christ and His teachings (Ephesians 4:11-13), and present an authentic representation of traditional, Biblical Christianity (Philippians 1:9-11). This role is vital in the running of the Shelters of the City Rescue Mission. The Coordinator must be friendly and encouraging while maintaining shelter policy and procedure with consistency and firmness.   • Attend all meetings and training sessions as scheduled
  • Show the love of Christ, be ready to share the gospel, and pray with guests regularly

  • Ability to learn a new computer program within 30 days of introduction

  • Detail oriented, organized, thorough, and possessing the ability to multitask well

  • Be ready at all times to give an answer of the Hope that lies within the committed follower of Christ, as outlined in the Christian Bible, with gentleness and respect (1 Peter 3:15).
  • Live everyday life in submission to the authority of the Christian Bible (2 Timothy 3:15-17).
  • Commit to continual training under those called to teach the doctrines of the faith and the Word of God, as well as to seek out fellowship with other believers (Hebrews 10:24-25), as evidenced by being a member in good standing in a local evangelical church.

Benefits:

As part of Versele, a global leader in premium animal nutrition, we combine the agility of a small company with the strength, resources, and long-term vision of an international organization.

At Higgins, every employee has the opportunity to make a meaningful impact. We value initiative, ownership, and continuous improvement. If you enjoy working in an environment where your ideas are heard, your contributions matter, and you can help shape the future of our operations, you'll fit right in.

About the Role

We are looking for a hands-on, self-driven Maintenance Manager to take ownership of our maintenance department. You will start by running the day-to-day backbone of maintenance: coordinating work with production, managing parts and records, and being the main contact for suppliers and contractors. You will stay close to the equipment and work alongside our maintenance lead on the floor.

This role is designed to grow. As you prove yourself, your responsibilities will expand into supplier negotiation, preventive maintenance planning, budget ownership, and broader operational responsibility, with a defined path to higher pay as your scope grows. This is an excellent opportunity for someone who wants to build a maintenance function, not just work within one.

Key Responsibilities

Department Ownership

  • Take ownership of the maintenance department, including its priorities, records, and results.
  • Coordinate day-to-day maintenance activity with production and our maintenance lead.
  • Work with production to schedule maintenance around production needs.
  • Identify problems and opportunities on your own and act on them without waiting to be asked.

Hands-On Maintenance

  • Troubleshoot, repair, and maintain mechanical and electrical equipment across the plant.
  • Support the maintenance lead on breakdowns and repairs on the floor.
  • Work on packaging machines and production equipment to keep lines running.
  • Document repairs and equipment history.

Systems, Parts & Suppliers

  • Manage work orders, maintenance records, and spare parts inventory.
  • Track parts usage, flag reorder needs, and keep records accurate and current.
  • Act as the point of contact for suppliers and outside contractors: quotes, orders, scheduling, and follow-up.

As You Grow Into the Role

  • Negotiate pricing and service terms with suppliers and contractors.
  • Build and run a preventive maintenance program.
  • Track and manage the maintenance budget.
  • Act as a backup to operations leadership and lead plant improvement initiatives.

Qualifications

Required

  • College diploma or equivalent by means of working experience.
  • 5+ years of hands-on maintenance experience in a manufacturing or industrial plant.
  • Working knowledge of mechanical and electrical systems, with the ability to diagnose and repair equipment.
  • Bilingual English/Spanish: professional English (written and spoken) for supplier communication, and Spanish to work with our plant team.
  • Comfortable with spreadsheets, records, and maintenance or inventory systems.
  • Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.

Preferred

  • Experience with packaging machines (bagging, filling, sealing, or similar).
  • Technical certificate or associate degree in industrial maintenance, or equivalent training.
  • Experience in food or feed manufacturing or another regulated environment (GMP/food safety).
  • PLC or automation exposure.
  • Experience buying from or negotiating with vendors.

What We're Looking For

We're looking for someone who:

  • Is comfortable getting into the machines and fixing problems personally.
  • Is a self-starter who takes initiative rather than waiting to be asked.
  • Treats the department as their own and takes responsibility for results, not just tasks.
  • Is comfortable building structure and processes where little exists today.
  • Enjoys working across departments and building strong relationships.
  • Wants a role that gets bigger as they do, and wants to grow into a broader operations role.

Why Join Higgins?

  • Be part of a company where your work has a visible impact.
  • Take real ownership of a department and help shape how maintenance works at our plant.
  • Grow into more responsibility, and higher pay, as you prove yourself.
  • Enjoy the flexibility, autonomy, and entrepreneurial culture of a small company backed by the stability, resources, and opportunities of an international market leader.

title: Shop Technician
description:
Position Summary

The Shop Technician supports the daily operations of Arpco Supply by maintaining accurate inventory, completing assigned fabrication and assembly work, assisting customers with counter sales, and performing routine building and shop maintenance.

This hands-on position helps ensure that products are properly received, stored, prepared, and delivered to customers; fabrication work meets approved specifications; and the facility remains safe, organized, and operational. The Shop Technician works closely with sales, purchasing, and management to meet customer needs and support efficient operations.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

Inventory Control and Warehouse Operations

  • Receive and inspect incoming materials, verifying part numbers, quantities, and condition against purchase orders and packing slips. Report shortages, damage, and discrepancies promptly.
  • Accurately record inventory receipts, transfers, returns, and materials used in fabrication. Label and store products in designated locations, and pick, package, and stage customer orders.
  • Complete scheduled inventory counts, investigate discrepancies, and submit necessary adjustments for approval. Communicate low-stock items, replenishment needs, and damaged or slow-moving inventory to the appropriate manager or purchasing contact.

Fabrication and Shop Work

  • Perform assigned fabrication and assembly activities according to approved work orders, drawings, measurements, and instructions. Depending on the products involved, tasks may include measuring, cutting, drilling, grinding, threading, fitting, and assembling materials or components.
  • Verify materials, dimensions, fit, and workmanship before releasing completed work. Report defects or unclear specifications, and obtain approval before making substitutions or changes.
  • Record materials used, completed quantities, and scrap as required. Maintain tools and shop equipment in serviceable condition, and perform only work for which the employee has been trained and authorized.

Counter Sales and Customer Support

  • Assist walk-in and telephone customers professionally, identify requested products, and verify part numbers, quantities, and specifications. Refer technical questions beyond the employee’s knowledge or authority to the appropriate team member.
  • Provide approved pricing and availability information, enter customer orders, and prepare sales tickets or other required documentation. Process payments and returns when assigned, following company procedures.
  • Coordinate order picking, staging, and customer pickup. Communicate shortages, backorders, and special-order needs, and obtain approval for discounts, substitutions, or commitments outside established authority.

Building, Shop, and Grounds Maintenance

  • Perform routine facility inspections, preventive upkeep, and minor repairs within the employee’s training and authorization. Examples may include painting, adjusting shelving or door hardware, and general shop or grounds upkeep.
  • Maintain orderly work areas, storage locations, walkways, and entrances. Identify and report damaged equipment, building concerns, and conditions that could affect safe operations.
  • Maintain basic maintenance records and assist approved service providers as directed. Refer specialized electrical, plumbing, heating and air-conditioning, structural, or other repairs beyond the employee’s qualifications to management.

title: Prime Financial Services Client Services Analyst

You will help guide the daily flow of the clinic, lead and develop team members, partner closely with our providers, Center Director, and Director of Surgical and Clinical Services, and help ensure our patients receive the remarkable experience they expect from ClearSight.

If you are a proven leader who communicates well, develops people, stays calm when the day gets busy, and isn't afraid to step in wherever the team needs you, we would love to meet you.

Our Core Values are daily guidelines to communicate and serve others; all employees are subject to these core values

Be Precise:

We don't use industry standards. We do better.

We say what we mean and mean what we say. - We get it right the first time, every time.

Honor Each Person:

We believe that people come first, and profits come second. We cut no corners.

Our patients are the most important people in the room, after our team.

Reach for Remarkable:

We find out what hasn't been done and do it awesome. - We compete against ourselves, not the other guys.

If it can be better, we're already there.

Stay Humble:

We ask what we can do for others before we ask ourselves what we can do for ourselves.

The only bad idea is one unshared.

We love what we do and have a ton of fun doing it! (By golly, be jolly!)

What You'll Do

As our Clinic Team Lead, you will help create an organized, efficient, and patient-focused environment while providing daily leadership to our clinical technicians.

You will:

  • Lead the daily workflow and assignments of the clinical technician team.
  • Manage technician schedules and adjust staffing based on patient volume, time-off requests, and unplanned absences.
  • Delegate responsibilities based on workflow, priorities, and the needs of the clinic.
  • Assist doctors and team members with complex situations while maintaining professionalism and exceptional patient care.
  • Serve as a liaison among patients, clinical technicians, doctors, and leadership.
  • Lead, train, mentor, and develop clinical technicians.
  • Participate in the hiring and onboarding of new team members in collaboration with the Center Director, and Director of Surgical and Clinical Services.
  • Complete employee assessments and performance evaluations in a timely manner.
  • Provide appropriate coaching, feedback, and verbal or written counseling when needed.
  • Assist with offboarding processes in partnership with leadership.
  • Organize and lead team meetings and training alongside the Center Director and Director of Surgical and Clinical Services.
  • Help implement policies, procedures, and operational changes and communicate them effectively to the team.
  • Ensure daily patient charts are reviewed, audited for accuracy, and completed
  • Serve as a point of contact for diagnostic equipment representatives and Dedicated IT.
  • Remain current on relevant clinical practices, policies, and organizational standards.
  • Take charge of time-sensitive or emergent situations with a calm, level-headed approach.
  • Step in and support other areas when needed to keep our patients and team moving forward.



What We're Looking For

This is not simply a senior technician position. This is a people's leadership position.

We are looking for someone with the clinical knowledge to earn the team's confidence and leadership ability to help people grow, communicate expectations, address concerns, and hold themselves and others accountable.

Required Qualifications:

  • High school diploma or equivalent.
  • Prior experience working as a clinical technician.
  • Proven leadership ability and demonstrated success leading, mentoring, coaching, or developing others.
  • Strong knowledge of clinic operations and technical procedures.
  • Excellent leadership, communication, and inter/intrapersonal skills.
  • Ability to manage schedules, establish priorities, and delegate effectively.
  • Ability to provide clear, timely, respectful feedback and address performance concerns when necessary.
  • Ability to train, mentor, motivate, and develop team members.
  • Ability to remain calm and composed during complex, fast-paced, or emergent situations.
  • Proficiency with EMR systems and daily chart management.
  • Strong computer and organizational skills, including working knowledge of Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Google Drive, or similar systems.
  • Ability to complete required departmental certifications within designated timeframes.
  • Ability to maintain required OSHA, HIPAA, and CPR training and certifications.
  • Ability to work a full-time schedule with flexibility based on business needs and participate in the weekend on-call rotation.
  • Ability to travel to other ClearSight locations, including Oklahoma City, for training or meetings as needed.
  • Professional references that can speak directly to your leadership, teamwork, communication, accountability, and performance will be required as part of the selection process. A 360-degree reference process may include former supervisors, peers, and individuals you have led or mentored.



Preferred:

  • Proven clinical training or certification.
  • Proven Successful Lead Position.


The Kind of Leader Who Thrives Here

You don't have to lead from the sidelines.

You are willing to take patients and serve in the rotation, solve a problem, help a teammate, answer a question, communicate a concern, and being able to anticipate what the team needs.

You understand that great leadership in clinic requires both confidence and humility. You know when to give direction, when to listen, when to coach, and when to simply roll up your sleeves and help.

You don't just say you're a strong leader. The people who have worked beside you, reported to you, and led you can tell us how you lead. Most importantly, you understand that everything we do ultimately comes back to taking exceptional care of our patients.



Why ClearSight?

For 30 years, ClearSight and our surgeons have helped people experience life with greater visual freedom. ClearSight is a privately owned company.

Our surgery team plays an important role in that experience. From preparing the surgical environment to supporting our physicians and reassuring patients, every detail matters.

We're looking for someone who wants to do more than perform the technical responsibilities of the job. We're looking for someone who wants to lead well, serve well, and help a great team become even better.

If that sounds like you, we'd love to hear from you.

Non-Exempt Full-Time 40 hours per week position. Full comprehensive benefits with matching 401K included in the offer.

No Phone Calls/Recruiters.

title: Laredo, Master Level Clinician
description:
AOC Outreach Services

Mental Health Associate



Mission Statement
AOC Outreach Services mission is to provide special needs children and
adults, and their families, the opportunity to succeed with our innovative and
effective programs. We strive to provide the best quality mental health services in
an effort for individuals to become self-empowering and develop strengths to live a
healthy and productive life.


Our Vision
AOC Outreach Services strives to provide life changing services to the
community of Texas. We will leave no stone unturned in the pursuit to extend the
pool of mental health resources while eradicating the negative stigma behind
mental health.


Role Purpose

The LPC-Associate will provide professional counseling and related behavioral health services under the supervision of an approved LPC Supervisor and in accordance with Texas law, the employee’s license and level of competence, applicable payer requirements, and AOC Outreach Services policies and procedures. The LPC-Associate will support clients in achieving their behavioral health goals through ethical, culturally responsive, and evidence-based counseling practices while maintaining accurate and timely clinical documentation.

The LPC-Associate is expected to practice within the scope of their provisional license and approved supervision arrangement and may not independently represent themselves as a fully licensed LPC when Texas law requires the LPC-Associate designation.



Responsibilities


  • Provide individual, family, and/or group counseling services within the scope permitted by the LPC-Associate license and approved supervision plan.
  • Complete clinical assessments, treatment planning, progress notes, and other required documentation in a timely and accurate manner.
  • Develop and maintain therapeutic relationships with clients while promoting a safe, respectful, and supportive environment.
  • Implement appropriate counseling interventions based on client needs, treatment goals, clinical training, and evidence-based practices.
  • Monitor client progress and communicate relevant changes, concerns, or barriers to treatment with the supervising LPC and appropriate members of the treatment team.
  • Participate in ongoing clinical supervision and incorporate supervisory feedback into clinical practice.
  • Maintain compliance with all applicable Texas laws, licensing board requirements, ethical standards, payer requirements, and AOC policies and procedures.
  • Maintain appropriate professional boundaries and protect client confidentiality in accordance with applicable laws and organizational policies.
  • Complete all required clinical, administrative, and compliance documentation within established timelines.
  • Participate in case consultations, staff meetings, trainings, and other professional development activities as required.
  • Coordinate with other service providers, caregivers, community resources, and members of the client’s support system when appropriate and authorized.
  • Identify and appropriately respond to client safety concerns, including following established procedures for crisis intervention, risk assessment, and mandatory reporting.
  • Maintain current licensure, supervision documentation, and other required professional credentials.
  • Perform other duties and responsibilities related to the position as assigned.


Qualifications


  • Current Texas LPC-Associate, LMSW, or LMFT license in good standing.
  • Active supervision relationship with a Texas Board-approved Supervisor, as required.
  • Knowledge of counseling principles, behavioral health practices, and ethical standards.
  • Ability to provide counseling services within the scope of training, competence, and licensure.
  • Strong communication, interpersonal, organization, and documentation skills.
  • Ability to establish and maintain professional therapeutic relationships with clients and families.
  • Ability to maintain confidentiality and exercise sound professional judgment.
  • Ability to work collaboratively with supervisors, clinical staff, clients, families, and community partners.
  • Commitment to ethical, culturally responsive, client-centered, and trauma-informed care.
  • Ability to meet AOC Outreach Services’ documentation, compliance, scheduling, and productivity requirements.
  • Must successfully complete all required onboarding, orientation, background checks, and organizational training.



Education


  • Master’s degree or higher in Counseling, Clinical Mental Health Counseling, Social Work, Psychology, or a closely related behavioral health field from an accredited institution.
  • Completion of educational and clinical requirements necessary to obtain and maintain Texas Associate licensure.
  • Additional training or continuing education related to behavioral health, trauma-informed care, crisis intervention, or specialized populations is preferred.

title: Urgent Care Advanced Practice Clinician (APP)
description:
Who We Are:

A dedicated group of health care providers practicing on the Eastside of Lake Washington since 1972, we became Evergreen Emergency Services (EES) in 2001. EES provides exceptional care and service to the patients of EvergreenHealth who are in need of emergent and urgent care. EES is dedicated to providing our patients with the highest quality of care and service possible. Every decision and every action by each of us is aimed toward this goal: We provide compassionate and efficient care. We believe that our patients are our most important assets. We place great importance on treating them with courtesy, fairness and respect regardless of their socio-economic background or reason for seeing us. We have a fun, collegial and supportive working environment and are actively engaged with the local community. Our shared values include Integrity, Excellence, Compassionate Care, Exceptional Patient Focus, Endurance and Passion.


Job Summary:

Under general supervision, is responsible for the medical care of urgent care patients. Treats patients in Urgent Care Clinics (UC) to ensure proper injury care and disease diagnosis, treatment, and recovery. Requests necessary tests and follow-up visits and refers patients to specialists, as necessary.


FTE: PART-TIME or FULL-TIME candidates will be considered.


Location: Negotiable / flexible. Clinics are located in Redmond, Woodinville, Mill Creek, Totem Lake, Kenmore, Monroe, and Bothell / Canyon Park.


Specific Duties & Responsibilities

    • Works collaboratively and supportively with members of the medical staff to provide quality, urgent care medical services for all patients who present to the UC. Provides leadership at the clinic and contributes to a positive work environment, working cooperatively with other clinical and non-clinical departments to ensure access, quality, and effective use of services.
    • Treats patients to ensure proper injury care and disease diagnosis, request necessary tests and follow-up visits. As necessary, stabilizes patient and coordinates transportation of patient to tertiary care centers. Relies on experience and judgment to plan and accomplish goals. Completes chart documentation in a timely manner.
    • Participates in the life of the company and the community.
    • Vigorously engages in his/her own professional development; is a life-long learner who enhances his/her skills, using state-of-the-art technologies to maintain high standards of performance to work efficiently and effectively.
    • Is familiar with and complies with all policies and regulations as put forth in the company’s documents.
    • Since safety and security are everyone’s responsibility, takes all necessary and reasonable precautions to protect employees, patients, equipment, materials and facilities.
    • Performs other duties as assigned.


    Required Education, Training & Experience:

    • Master's Degree from an accredited Advanced Nurse Practitioner program or graduation from a Physician Assistant (PA) Training Program accredited by the American Medical Association Council on Medical Education
    • Licensed as a Family Nurse Practitioner, Registered Nurse or Physician Assistant with a current valid, full and unrestricted license in Washington State
    • Current BLS and ACLS
    • Maintains Continuing Medical Education (CME) requirements
    • Minimum two years of acute care experience required
    • No more than twelve (12) months since last work assignment preferred


    Required Knowledge, Skills & Abilities:

    • Familiarity with standard UC concepts, practices, and procedures. Prior use of an EMR and ability to learn a new system.
    • Creativity, adaptability, ability to multitask
    • Ability to work well with teammates as well as in an individual contributor role
    • Ability to provide leadership among equals
    • Ability to work and communicate well with all company and hospital employees as well as patients and their families
    • Excellent written and verbal communications skills
    • Excellent problem-solving, risk assessment, negotiation, and conflict-resolution skills
    • Excellent customer service skills
    • Excellent professional (email, phone, letter) etiquette
    • Ability to maintain confidential information
    • Ability to confidently learn new technology
    • Ability to sit, climb or balance, and stoop, kneel, crouch, or crawl
    • Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, distance vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception, and ability to adjust focus
    • Ability to lift up to 50 pounds
    • Ability to travel locally


    We look forward to hearing from you!

title: Quality Assurance Manager
description:
Quality Assurance Manager- Food Manufacturing

Hayward, CA | Full-Time | 100% Onsite

Job Description

The Quality Assurance Manager will manage, coordinate, and implement quality assurance (QA) programs for plant operations. Monitor production, warehouse, maintenance
and sanitation operations for adherence to quality and food safety programs. Monitor product conformance to quality specifications including complaint investigation and resolution



This is a full-time, onsite position. Remote or hybrid work is not available.


Key Responsibilities

  • Develop, implement, and maintain the plant’s Food Safety Plan and HACCP program in compliance with the FDA’s food safety rule for manufacturers (FSMA, 21 CFR Part 117)
  • Manage the SQF Food Safety Code program and lead preparation for the annual certification audit
  • Serve as the primary contact for FDA, state, and local inspections and for customer and third-party audits, and manage all corrective actions
  • Oversee the allergen control program, including cross-contact prevention, label checks, and validation of cleaning between product runs
  • Partner with the Sanitation team to maintain cleaning schedules and written cleaning procedures, and to verify that equipment is clean before production starts
  • Conduct internal GMP and food safety inspections across all shifts, and track findings until they are resolved
  • Monitor finished products against quality specifications, and take part in taste and quality reviews and shelf-life testing
  • Investigate consumer and customer complaints, find the root causes, and put fixes in place that prevent repeat problems, with a focus on preventing foreign objects in product
  • Manage the approved supplier program, including incoming ingredient quality, supplier certificates and specifications, and handling of rejected materials
  • Maintain traceability, product recall procedures, and plans to protect products from tampering and ingredient fraud, and run mock recalls at least once a year
  • Provide technical support to co-packers and suppliers, including reviews of their allergen and HACCP plans
  • Set and report on food safety and quality performance measures to senior leadership
  • Deliver GMP, food safety, allergen, and sanitation training to new and current associates, and keep training records up to date
  • Lead, coach, and develop the QA team, and support Lean and continuous improvement work across the plant



Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Food Science, Microbiology, Biology, Chemistry, or a related field
  • Minimum of 5 years of quality assurance experience in food manufacturing, including at least 2 years in a supervisory or management role
  • Preventive Controls Qualified Individual (PCQI) and HACCP certifications required
  • SQF Practitioner certification required, or ability to obtain it within 90 days of hire
  • In-depth knowledge of FSMA, GMPs, allergen management, sanitation programs, and GFSI-recognized food safety standards
  • Proven experience leading SQF or other GFSI certification audits and regulatory inspections
  • Experience in bakery
    or high-speed packaged food production preferred
  • Strong English communication skills, written and verbal. Fluency in Spanish strongly preferred
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office, and familiarity with quality, ERP and timekeeping systems



Key Attributes

  • Puts consumer safety first and makes sound decisions, even under pressure
  • Stays calm and decisive during audits, deviations, and investigations
  • Pays close attention to detail and uses data to solve problems
  • Leads visibly on the production floor and earns trust across all shifts

Work Environment
The role involves regular work on the production floor, including hot, cold, wet, and noisy areas. Candidates must follow all PPE and hygiene requirements, be able to lift up to 50 lbs, and be flexible to cover multiple shifts as needed.

Wisoman Foods Inc. is an Equal Opportunity Employer.



Why work for us?

  • Opportunity to contribute to a growing, mission-driven food company.
  • Work closely with a collaborative, passionate team.
  • Gain hands-on experience in all aspects of procurement and sourcing in the specialty food sector.
  • Benefits: Health, Dental, Vision
  • Paid Holidays
  • PTO (Vacation and Sick)

title: L&D Specialist

  • Developing blended learning solutions including digital learning, microlearning, workshops, toolkits and on-the-job resources

  • Managing external training providers and evaluating learning effectiveness

  • Proven experience designing and delivering workplace learning solutions
  • Strong knowledge of instructional design and adult learning principles
  • Experience consulting with stakeholders to diagnose capability needs and recommend solutions
  • Demonstrated ability to manage learning initiatives from scoping through to evaluation
  • Strong communication, influencing and relationship-building skills

At Liebherr, we value your well-being. We offer a culture of recognition and reward, celebrating your contributions and ensuring you feel valued.

You'll have access to generous benefits like retail and medical insurance discounts, bonus leave days, parental leave, and comprehensive training programs, fostering your personal and professional growth.

We aim to give our employees an opportunity to grow and develop their careers.

Please apply via the link - No Agencies or Third Parties please.

title: Engineering Intern Spring 2027
description:
About Us

Air Systems Maintenance, Inc. (ASM) is a leading commercial HVAC maintenance, service, and contracting company based in Kenilworth, NJ. Founded in 1964, we have decades of experience servicing commercial and industrial facilities throughout New Jersey, New York, and Pennsylvania. Our experienced technicians work on everything from rooftop units to large-scale chillers, with a strong focus on quality, reliability, and customer service.



About the Role

Air System Maintenance (ASM) is seeking a motivated Engineering Intern interested in gaining hands-on experience in the HVAC and commercial building systems industry while earning academic credit toward their engineering degree.

The intern will work alongside ASM’s engineering, service, and operations teams, applying classroom knowledge to real-world HVAC, mechanical, and building systems projects.

Key Responsibilities

  • Assist with HVAC and mechanical system projects, inspections, and assessments.
  • Support equipment documentation, inventories, and preventive maintenance tracking.
  • Collect and analyze equipment and operational data.
  • Assist with engineering calculations, measurements, reports, and technical documentation.
  • Review equipment specifications, drawings, manuals, and system documentation.
  • Support energy-efficiency and building optimization initiatives.
  • Participate in field visits and site inspections.
  • Assist with project coordination and tracking.

title: Counselor/Phone Flex
description:
General Summary:

The Counselor/Phone Flex employee provides non-judgmental, integrated, counseling services addressing the full scope of emotional, medical, and spiritual needs of a patient who is making a pregnancy decision. Responsible for providing reproductive health counseling to patients, their partners and families. This includes pre-abortion, post-abortion, pregnancy options counseling and contraception counseling. The Counselor is expected to display a mastery of psycho-social issues related to pregnancy decisions including but not limited to positive coping, social support, partner violence, drug and alcohol use, sexual assault, prior or current abuse, safety concerns and physical, mental health or cognitive disabilities. Counselors will help patients and Allegheny Reproductive Health Center (ARHC) maintain compliance with all federal and state laws surrounding abortions services and are mandated reporters of Child Protective Services law.

The Counselor/Phone Flex also provides support to patients seeking medical care and serves as the patients’ first point of contact. Assists with general office, clinic and administrative duties, as assigned.


Principal Duties and Responsibilities:

  1. Provides brief counseling, informed consent sessions, and reproductive health education to a diverse population of patients seeking abortion services.
  2. Provides quality, competent care in communication with patients and other individuals contacting the office by demonstrating following skills: answering the telephone, scheduling and confirming appointments, patient triage, providing appropriate answers to questions from individuals contacting ARHC, responding to voicemails and emails, cross-training in various areas of the clinic to fill in for absent staff as needed, and any other office tasks assigned.
  3. Addresses medical, emotional, spiritual, and/or relationship issues that patients may present in a way that encourages healthy coping and resilience.
  4. Explains the abortion procedure and the steps involved in having the procedure. Reviews all consent forms and witnesses signatures.
  5. Educates patients about contraceptive use and STI-prevention if desired, developing personalized plans for family planning based on prior contraceptive use and future contraceptive goals.
  6. Conducts pre-abortion, options, and post-abortion counseling sessions as needed with patients, their partners, and / or families.
  7. Sets up patient charts for the OR. Reviews chart to ensure that proper paperwork and documentation is present and the chart is complete.
  8. Provides appropriate referrals for a wide spectrum of community resources, reproductive health needs and mental health services when needed.
  9. Designs support plans for patients with immediate safety needs, including those in crisis, at risk for partner violence or in recovery.
  10. Assists minors seeking to obtain an abortion through the judicial bypass process.
  11. Ensures that all consent forms, counseling, and resource materials are stocked and up to date.
  12. Understands and complies with state mandated reporting requirements and Child Protective Services Law.
  13. Assists in daily administrative tasks as needed.

Any other duties as assigned by supervisor.


Skills/Qualifications:

  1. Ability to provide crisis management
  2. Demonstrate excellent verbal and written communication skills
  3. Ability to communicate professionally, objectively and, non-judgmentally with patients and/or guests and family members from a wide range of ethnic, religious and socio-economic backgrounds.
  4. Ability to mediate between family members and/or patients and their guests when needed.
  5. Facilitate decision-making for patients, partners/family, etc.
  6. Assessment skills and ability to set boundaries.
  7. Knowledge of local resources and ability to access additional resources as needed.
  8. Current CPR certification or willingness to obtain CPR certification
  9. Ability to be self-motivated, as well as take instruction and guidance from others.
  10. Ability to work under conditions of stress with minimal supervision and direction.


Working Conditions:

Employee will interact with a variety of people of various ages, experience and points of reference. Patients may be experiencing emotional stress which may result in ambivalent behavior. Employees may also expect to encounter individuals who are strongly anti-abortion and may verbally harass or possibly threaten employees and/or patients. Possible exposure to contaminated specimens and other conditions associated with a health center environment.

We are looking for a highly organized and detail-oriented Property Administrator to support our residential and commercial rental portfolio. Reporting to the Senior Manager of Administration, this role works closely with Property Managers, Superintendents, vendors, contractors and internal teams to keep contracts, procurement activities, inspections and property operations accurate, compliant and on schedule. title: Deputy Dog Warden 2
description:
Deputy Dog Warden 2

Reports to Chief Dog Warden



Join the Team at Cincinnati Animal CARE

At Cincinnati Animal CARE (CAC), we do work that matters.

Every day, our team protects animals, supports our community, and helps save thousands of lives each year through compassionate care, advocacy, and education.

This work is meaningful, fast-paced, and can be challenging, but for the right person, it’s incredibly rewarding.

We are a team built for impact, made up of people who care deeply, work hard, support one another, and show up every day committed to making a difference.

If you are passionate about animals, thrive in a mission-driven environment, and want your work to have purpose, we’d love to have you join us.


About the Role

We are looking for a Deputy Dog Warden 2 to join our team and play an important role in supporting CAC’s mission.

In this position, you will:


  • Enforce Ohio Revised Code (ORC) Chapter 955, conduct field investigations, issue citations, prepare reports and court documentation, handle and transport animals safely, maintain required records, and assist during emergency situations.
  • Respond to animal related complaints, capture and impound stray animals, investigate dog bites and nuisance animal cases
  • Educate the public on responsible pet ownership.

This is a great opportunity for someone who enjoys meaningful work, takes pride in helping others, and wants to contribute to a growing organization making a real impact in the community.


Dog Warden Levels

Deputy Dog Warden 1: carries firearms, more time dedicated to ORC 959 pertaining to animal cruelty and neglect investigations.

Deputy Dog Warden 2: does not carry firearms; more time dedicated to ORC 955 pertaining to stray dogs and dog bites.


What You’ll Be Responsible For

Your day-to-day may include:

Law Enforcement and Animal Control

  • Enforce Ohio Revised Code Chapters 955, and 959 as needed, and applicable animal control regulations within Hamilton County.
  • Respond to animal-related calls for service and public complaints.
  • Investigate reports involving stray, lost, injured, dangerous, nuisance, neglected, or abused animals.
  • Patrol assigned areas to locate, capture, return, or impound stray, unlicensed, or at-large animals.
  • Conduct dog license compliance checks and issue citations, notices of violation, and criminal complaints when appropriate.
  • Appear in court and provide testimony related to investigations and enforcement actions.

Animal Care and Handling

  • Safely capture, handle, transport, and impound animals using approved equipment and methods.
  • Provide basic animal care and first aid as directed by the CAC Medical Director.
  • Set and monitor live traps when necessary to safely confine animals running at large.
  • Communicate clearly with shelter staff to determine disposition and transfer of animals with behavior or medical concerns.
  • Maintain accurate records for impounded animals and related case activity.

Investigations and Documentation

  • Conduct thorough investigations of animal cruelty, neglect, abandonment, dog bite, and other animal-related incidents.
  • Collect, preserve, and document evidence for administrative, civil, or criminal proceedings.
  • Complete required reports, forms, case files, and statistical records in accordance with agency policy and legal requirements.
  • Maintain records required for animal quarantines and public health compliance.

Community Engagement

  • Educate the public on animal control laws, responsible pet ownership, animal safety, and available resources.
  • Respond to public inquiries and assist in resolving animal-related disputes and concerns.
  • Participate in community outreach and educational programs as assigned.

Emergency Response and Equipment Maintenance

  • Assist during emergencies, disasters, and incidents requiring animal control intervention.
  • Coordinate with law enforcement, public safety agencies, veterinarians, and community partners as needed.
  • Maintain and clean assigned vehicles, equipment, and animal handling tools.

Other Duties

  • Perform other duties and special assignments as directed


What Makes Someone Successful in This Role

We’re looking for someone who:

  • Is passionate about CAC’s mission and animal welfare
  • Brings a positive, team-first attitude
  • Communicates openly and professionally
  • Takes ownership and solves problems proactively
  • Thrives in a fast-paced, ever-changing environment
  • Can balance compassion with accountability
  • Is dependable, adaptable, and eager to learn

Qualifications

Preferred/Required:

  • Graduation from a standard high school or the equivalency
  • Must be 21 years or older
  • Resident of Hamilton County or within 15 mile radius of the Northside shelter (3949 Colerain Ave, 45223) for emergency response purposes preferred, but not required
  • Valid driver’s license and ability to operate a vehicle, including a large van
  • Ability to define problems, collect data, establish facts, and draw valid conclusions
  • Report writing and documentation
  • Conflict resolution and mediation.
  • Thorough knowledge of the occupational hazards and corresponding safety precautions necessary for the safe performance of assigned duties
  • Thorough knowledge of animal control ordinances
  • Knowledge of local and state laws and regulations
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills
  • Adherence to the applicable provisions of the Cincinnati Animal CARE Humane Society’s policy guidelines
  • Must have personal integrity and remain free of felony convictions and most misdemeanor offenses.
  • Must maintain confidentiality and follow due process in prosecution cases
  • Must be able to be on call 24 hours a day, 7 days a week (rotating schedule)
  • Must be bondable
  • Must be able to lift 50+ lbs
  • Law enforcement experience preferred

Certificates, Licenses, Registrations (at the time of hire or within the recommended period after employment):

  • Within 6 months of employment, successful completion of NACA Level I and II Animal Control Officer Course.
  • Possession of a proper current State of Ohio motor vehicle operator’s license for type of equipment operated.
  • Ability to obtain weapons, O/C chemical spray, Baton, Taser and Defensive Tactics certifications within the first six months of employment.

Work Specs and Availability:

  • Potential for rotating shifts based on training level and organizational needs
  • 8 or 10 hour shifts
  • 2 shifts to cover 16 hours; first shift 6am-2:30pm, second shift 1:30-10pm
  • On-call availability between 10pm-6am, as assigned
  • Holiday availability
  • Weekend availability


Why Join CAC?

At CAC, you’ll be part of more than just a workplace. You’ll join a team of people doing meaningful work together.

We offer:

  • The opportunity to make a real difference every day
  • A mission-driven, supportive team culture
  • Growth and development opportunities
  • Competitive benefits package
  • A workplace where your work directly impacts animals and the community

Compensation & Benefits

  • Pay: From $23.44/hour minimum after training period; $20.51 during training period
  • Retirement plan with employer match
  • Health, Dental, and Vision Insurance
  • Paid Time Off
  • Professional Development Assistance
  • Life Insurance

Working Conditions / Physical Requirements

  • Danger from moving traffic
  • Exposure to aggressive and sick animals
  • Exposure to zoonotic diseases and parasites
  • Temperature level will vary from extreme cold to extreme heat
  • Moisture level will vary from extreme dry to rain, snow, and ice conditions and may require immersion in water
  • May require evening, weekend, and holiday work.
  • On-call availability for emergency situations.

description:
Our team is expanding, and we are looking for an experienced Auto Body Technician to join our team. What does joining our team offer?

A unique blend of independence, excitement, growth opportunities, and a supportive work culture. We are an employee-centric team, and we want you to join us!

What do our Auto Body Technicians do?


SUMMARY:

The Auto Body Technician is responsible for repairing damaged vehicle body parts in accordance with company specifications, processes and time standards. The Auto Body Technician is skilled in analyzing, assessing and fixing damaged vehicles. This role is responsible for repairing, replacing and refinishing outer body parts. This position will also be skilled in fixing internal automotive structures.


ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS AND RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Repairs vehicles per estimate and according to established standards. This position prepares vehicles for body repair work. Additionally, the Auto Body Technician will be challenged with restoring bodywork to its original condition. This may include removing damaged parts and installing replacement parts utilizing specialized tools to repair the damage and realign structural components.
  • Communicates with management regarding any additional repairs that may be needed on a customer’s vehicle. Notifies management of any difficulties or problems that may prevent a quality job from being performed or cause a change in the promised completion/delivery time.

title: Senior Operator
description:
Company Overview:

NDS, part of the Advanced Drainage Systems (ADS) family of companies, is a leading provider of stormwater, irrigation, and flow management solutions. Since 1972, NDS has helped protect and enhance properties through innovative water management products and trusted customer support. Together with ADS, we are committed to preserving water for future generations while delivering sustainable solutions for residential, commercial, infrastructure, and agricultural applications.

Responsibilities and Qualifications:

We are seeking a Senior Operator for 3rd Shift who is responsible for performing the core functions of a Machine Operator while providing additional operational support to the production team. In coordination with the Sr. Lead and/or Supervisor, the Senior Operator assists with employee break and lunch coverage, ensures workstations remain supplied with required components, and supports the movement and preparation of finished product for warehousing. This position also assists with pallet wrapping and staging, box building, scanning, labeling, and label printing. The Senior Operator helps maintain safe, organized, and efficient production operations while supporting quality, productivity, and adherence to company policies and procedures.

Responsibilities:

Safety and 5S

  • Follow all company safety policies and requirements.
  • Wear PPE as required.
  • Follow proper ergonomic practices, including safe lifting, bending, and twisting techniques.
  • Report incidents in a timely manner.
  • Identify and report potential safety risks through VBS.
  • Maintain 5S standards throughout the plant and complete required 5S checklists, including keeping work areas clean and ensuring shadow boards are properly stocked.

Production and Material Handling

  • Load and unload items from machines, conveyors, and conveyances.
  • Assist Machine Operators with production activities.
  • Remove products or work pieces from production equipment.
  • Load and unload inserts into molds when required.
  • Process products, including assembly, inspection, and wrapping.
  • Monitor operating equipment to detect malfunctions.
  • Operate electric and manual pallet jacks.
  • Operate wrapping machines as required.
  • Examine products to verify conformance to quality standards.
  • Scan production parts using handheld scanners.

Support Machine Operators

  • Provide break and lunch coverage as assigned by the Sr. Lead and/or Supervisor and complete hourly boards when substituting for Machine Operators.
  • Remove completed pallets from machines.
  • Wrap completed pallets using hand wrap and automatic wrapping equipment.
  • Provide backup support to Machine Operators as needed.
  • Ensure workstations have the required WIP components.
  • Retrieve, build, and deliver boxes to machines.
  • Print and deliver labels as required.

Production Documentation

  • Read, understand, and complete travelers accurately.
  • Record production scrap data on production scrap reports.
  • Complete hourly boards as required.
  • Understand and sign break and lunch forms and confirm operators are complying with company break and lunch policies.

Other

  • Perform other duties and responsibilities as directed from time to time.

Position Requirements:

Education

  • High school diploma or General Education Degree (GED).

Experience

  • Three to six months of related experience and/or training; or an equivalent combination of education and experience.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

  • Ability to coordinate hand movements and use both hands to grasp, manipulate, or assemble objects.
  • Ability to bend, stretch, twist, or reach with the body, arms, and/or legs.
  • Ability to make fast, simple, repetitive movements with the fingers, hands, and wrists.

Work Conditions:

  • Work environment may occasionally include cold, hot, wet, and humid conditions.
  • Exposure to moving mechanical parts, confined work areas, and high noise levels. Hearing protection will be provided.
  • Ability to perform physical activities that require moving the whole body, including climbing, lifting, balancing, walking, and stooping.
  • Physical activities often require considerable use of the arms and legs, including the physical handling of materials.

This job description is not intended to be all-inclusive. Employee may perform other related duties to meet the ongoing needs of the organization.

Company Benefits:

NDS offers excellent benefits options as part of the total compensation package with a suite of options covering Life, Medical, Dental, and Vision as well as a 401k Retirement Plans.
