We are looking for a Deputy Dog Warden 1 to join our team and play an important role in supporting CAC’s mission.

In this position, you will:

  • Enforce Ohio Revised Code (ORC) Chapters 955 and 959, conduct field investigations, issue citations, prepare reports and court documentation, handle and transport animals safely, collect evidence for legal proceedings, maintain required records, and assist during emergency situations.
  • Respond to animal-related complaints, capture and impound stray animals, and investigate dog bites, cruelty, neglect, and nuisance animal cases
  • Educate the public on responsible pet ownership.

This is a great opportunity for someone who enjoys meaningful work, takes pride in helping others, and wants to contribute to a growing organization making a real impact in the community.


Dog Warden Levels

Deputy Dog Warden 1: carries firearms, more time dedicated to ORC 959 pertaining to animal cruelty and neglect investigations

Deputy Dog Warden 2: does not carry firearms; more time dedicated to ORC 955 pertaining to stray dogs and dog bites


What You’ll Be Responsible For

Your day-to-day may include:

Law Enforcement and Animal Control

  • Enforce Ohio Revised Code Chapters 955 and 959 and applicable animal control regulations within Hamilton County.
  • Respond to animal-related calls for service and public complaints.
  • Investigate reports involving stray, lost, injured, dangerous, nuisance, neglected, or abused animals.
  • Patrol assigned areas to locate, capture, return, or impound stray, unlicensed, or at-large animals.
  • Conduct dog license compliance checks and issue citations, notices of violation, and criminal complaints when appropriate.
  • Appear in court and provide testimony related to investigations and enforcement actions.

Animal Care and Handling

  • Safely capture, handle, transport, and impound animals using approved equipment and methods.
  • Provide basic animal care and first aid as directed by the CAC Medical Director.
  • Set and monitor live traps when necessary to safely confine animals running at large.
  • Communicate clearly with shelter staff to determine disposition and transfer of animals with behavior or medical concerns.
  • Maintain accurate records for impounded animals and related case activity.

Investigations and Documentation

  • Conduct thorough investigations of animal cruelty, neglect, abandonment, dog bite, and other animal-related incidents.
  • Collect, preserve, and document evidence for administrative, civil, or criminal proceedings.
  • Complete required reports, forms, case files, and statistical records in accordance with agency policy and legal requirements.
  • Maintain records required for animal quarantines and public health compliance.

Community Engagement

  • Educate the public on animal control laws, responsible pet ownership, animal safety, and available resources.
  • Respond to public inquiries and assist in resolving animal-related disputes and concerns.
  • Participate in community outreach and educational programs as assigned.

Emergency Response and Equipment Maintenance

  • Assist during emergencies, disasters, and incidents requiring animal control intervention.
  • Coordinate with law enforcement, public safety agencies, veterinarians, and community partners as needed.
  • Maintain and clean assigned vehicles, equipment, and animal handling tools.

Other Duties

  • Perform other duties and special assignments as directed

What Makes Someone Successful in This Role

We’re looking for someone who:

  • Is passionate about CAC’s mission and animal welfare
  • Brings a positive, team-first attitude
  • Communicates openly and professionally
  • Takes ownership and solves problems proactively
  • Thrives in a fast-paced, ever-changing environment
  • Can balance compassion with accountability
  • Is dependable, adaptable, and eager to learn


Qualifications

Preferred/Required:

  • Graduation from a standard high school or the equivalency
  • Must be 21 years or older
  • Resident of Hamilton County or within 15 mile radius of the Northside shelter (3949 Colerain Ave, 45223) for emergency response purposes preferred, but not required
  • Professional firearms training and certifications
  • Valid driver’s license and ability to operate a vehicle, including a large van
  • Ability to define problems, collect data, establish facts, and draw valid conclusions
  • Report writing and documentation
  • Conflict resolution and mediation.
  • Thorough knowledge of the occupational hazards and corresponding safety precautions necessary for the safe performance of assigned duties
  • Thorough knowledge of animal control ordinances
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills
  • Adherence to the applicable provisions of the Cincinnati Animal CARE Humane Society’s policy guidelines
  • Must have personal integrity and remain free of felony convictions and most misdemeanor offenses.
  • Must maintain confidentiality and follow due process in prosecution cases
  • Must be able to be on call 24 hours a day, 7 days a week (rotating schedule)
  • Must be bondable
  • Must be able to lift 50+ lbs
  • Law enforcement experience preferred


Certificates, Licenses, Registrations (at the time of hire or within the recommended period after employment):

  • Within 6 months of employment, successful completion of NACA Level I and II Animal Control Officer Course.
  • Possession of a proper current State of Ohio motor vehicle operator’s license for type of equipment operated.
  • Ability to obtain weapons, O/C chemical spray, Baton, Taser and Defensive Tactics certifications within the first six months of employment.


Work Specs and Availability:

  • Potential for rotating shifts based on training level and organizational needs
  • 8 or 10 hour shifts
  • 2 shifts to cover 16 hours; first shift 6am-2:30pm, second shift 1:30-10pm
  • On-call availability between 10pm-6am, as assigned
  • Holiday availability
  • Weekend availability


Why Join CAC?

At CAC, you’ll be part of more than just a workplace. You’ll join a team of people doing meaningful work together.

We offer:

  • The opportunity to make a real difference every day
  • A mission-driven, supportive team culture
  • Growth and development opportunities
  • Competitive benefits package
  • A workplace where your work directly impacts animals and the community

Compensation & Benefits

  • Pay: From $25.90/hour after successful completion of 90 day training period, $22.40 during training period
  • Retirement plan with employer match
  • Health, Dental, and Vision Insurance
  • Paid Time Off
  • Professional Development Assistance
  • Life Insurance


Working Conditions / Physical Requirements

  • Danger from moving traffic
  • Exposure to aggressive and sick animals
  • Exposure to zoonotic diseases and parasites
  • Temperature level will vary from extreme cold to extreme heat
  • Moisture level will vary from extreme dry to rain, snow, and ice conditions and may require immersion in water
  • May require evening, weekend, and holiday work.
  • On-call availability for emergency situations.

title: Children's Programmer (ECE)
description:
About the role:

The Children’s Programmer plays an important role in the delivery of NYWS’ child and youth programs with guidance from the Manager, Programs & Services. This role is responsible for facilitating age-appropriate educational and recreational programs to support the positive social and emotional development of NYWS’ children and youth Clients in alignment with our principles of trauma-informed practice.


What you will be doing:

  • Foster and maintain a trauma-informed, respectful, and inclusive environment for Clients, colleagues, volunteers, and other members of the NYWS internal and external community while adhering to NYWS' policies and procedures.
  • Facilitate age-appropriate activities and programs for NYWS' children and youth Clients based on guidance and direction from the Manager, Programs and Services to help promote positive social and emotional development e.g., building confidence and self-esteem, healthy relationships, self-regulation and coping, using play and inquiry-based learning strategies.
  • Foster diversity, equity, and inclusion by considering diverse cultures, physical abilities, neurodiversity, and lived experiences of children and youth in the delivery of programs as well as in communication with children and youth and their caregivers.
  • Facilitate programming in age-appropriate ways such as storytelling, creative arts, sensory play, media, indoor and outdoor activities, and both individual and group learning experiences to support a variety of learning styles and developmental milestones.
  • Adapt facilitation and delivery to accommodate diverse needs, interests, and abilities of participants, ensuring engaging, inclusive, and enjoyable learning opportunities for all.
  • Actively participate in indoor and outdoor activities with children and youth while modelling and encouraging positive social skills, e.g., clear communication and constructive conflict resolution skills.
  • Provide direct support to children and youth, including group interactions that foster safety, trust, and well-being.
  • Provide individualized attention and care, recognizing and responding to developmental milestones and unique challenges at various stages of development (infants, toddlers, school-aged children, adolescents).
  • Address inappropriate behaviour in a respectful and inclusive manner which helps facilitate reflection and growth.
  • Recognize and de-escalate challenging situations in a trauma-informed manner.
  • Notify the Programs and Services leadership of any supplies or equipment needed to support programming.
  • Prepare program spaces and materials before activities and ensure program areas are cleaned, organized, and restored following each shift.
  • Follow protocols for safety and security and proactively identify and report safety and operational concerns with the Programs and Services leadership.
  • Maintain accurate and consistent program documentation including incident reports, key performance indicators/ metrics to support operational effectiveness, and program evaluation, funder requirements, compliance, and continuous improvement of child and youth programs and activities.
  • Demonstrate professional conduct that aligns with NYWS's values and provides safety, support, and empowerment for Clients.
  • Collaborate with the Programs and Services team to support areas where children and youth may need additional support.
  • Provide child-minding support to residents during groups and weekly meetings.
  • Uphold confidentiality of all Clients and staff in accordance with organizational policies.
  • Attend and participate in additional team building, training, and community outreach projects as required.
  • Support NYWS in remaining current and active in harm reduction policy development and community advocacy.
  • Collaborate closely with staff to ensure continuity of care and consistent, high-quality support for children and youth.
  • Maintain flexibility and availability to work relief shifts as needed to support operational and program requirements.
  • Proactively uphold our principles of trauma-informed practice.
  • Additional duties as assigned.

Who you are:

Your Education and Experience

  • You have completed or are currently enrolled in your last year of post-secondary education in Early Childhood Education Child Development and/or presently hold a Bachelor’s Degree in Psychology, Child Development, Education, and Family and Social Services.
  • You have experience and/or training in designing and implementing programs and activities for children and youth.
  • You have 2-3 years of experience working in summer camps, after-school programs, recreational programs, or similar child and youth-focused environments
  • You have experience and/or training in trauma-informed care or mental health.
  • You can demonstrate a strong understanding of child and youth development, trauma-informed care, and culturally responsive practices.
  • You have or are willing to provide a satisfactory Vulnerable Sector Check (PVSC) with future checks.
  • You have completed CPR Level C and First Aid certifications.

Your Skills and Competencies

  • You have basic knowledge of Microsoft Office tools e.g., Outlook and Word.
  • You take ownership for tasks and have strong work ethic.
  • You demonstrate excellent professional and empathetic communication skills.
  • You have strong problem solving and critical thinking skills.
  • You are able to document and take comprehensive notes.
  • You can work effectively independently as well as part of a team.
  • You are committed to understanding and working from an intersectional feminist, anti-racist, and anti-oppressive lens.
  • You have a high degree of confidentiality and discretion.
  • You can work under pressure and in crisis situations.
  • You are comfortable working in a pet-friendly environment.

The following additional qualifications would be considered assets:

  • Experience working with survivors of violence and their dependents.
  • Fluency with speaking and/or writing in additional languages.



Working Conditions:

  • This role operates in a Gender-Based Violence (GBV) Shelter which provides Client services inclusive of adults, children, youth, and houses pets (dogs and cats).
  • May be required to lift up to 30 lbs.
  • Walking, standing, bending, stooping, reaching, twisting, lifting, pushing, pulling, and/or moving items.
  • Speaking and listening on the telephone and using a computer.
  • Exposure to GBV and IPV subject matter and cases.
  • Occasional exposure to animals (dogs and cats).
  • Occasional exposure to loud sounds.
  • Occasional exposure to interpersonal conflict.
  • Occasional exposure to substance use.

How to apply:

Does this sound like the right opportunity for you? If so, please apply with your resume on BambooHR. Only applications submitted by October 13, 2026 at 5PM through the BambooHR application portal will be considered. Only candidates selected for an interview will be contacted. Please do not call the Shelter.

title: Sr Analyst, SC Finance & External Manufacturing, MENAP
description:
Job Description

Job Description


Are You Ready to Make It Happen at Mondelēz International?



Join our Mission to Lead the Future of Snacking. Make It Uniquely Yours.



You will perform detailed finance work, transactions and data structuring under the guidance of the Finance Manager. You will collect data, be responsible for maintaining information integrity, monitor reconciliations and conduct basic checks and controls.



How you will contribute



You will:


  • Execute aspects of finance planning and performance management process and related financial decisions potentially including Annual Contract planning/forecasting, target development, financial performance reporting/analysis, financial modeling and decision support for a focused scope within a region, business unit, country, Supply Chain, Mondelēz International Business Services or Corporate Finance team. You will also execute data collection and data integrity checks
  • Contribute to a strong controls and compliance environment in area of scope and ensure full compliance with our policies
  • Execute ad hoc analyses and projects as requested by the Senior Finance Manager (or Director)
  • Support projects to improve efficiencies and improvements to ways of working and embrace a mindset of continuous improvement
  • Contribute to a high-performing Finance team. You will also invest in personal development and the development of your Finance peers

What you will bring



A desire to drive your future and accelerate your career. You will bring experience and knowledge in:


  • TECHNICAL EXPERTISE in financial analysis and data collection/structuring
  • BUSINESS ACUMEN and a basic understanding of our business, consumer packaged goods industry, and local snacking market. Relevant experience in a regional (or sizeable local) business
  • LEADERSHIP SKILLS including collaboration and communication skills within a larger Finance team. Team player with can do mentality to deliver results
  • GROWTH/DIGITAL MINDSET and the ability to execute opportunities and leverage technology to improve operational efficiency and effectiveness
  • INTEGRITY and sound judgement in all decisions and interactions aligned with our values and policies and external regulations

More about this role


This role is responsible for end-to-end ownership of the COGS P&L. It combines financial planning, forecasting, and cost controllership with strong cross-functional collaboration across manufacturing and supply chain teams.
Unlike traditional reporting roles, this position plays a forward-looking role in shaping cost structures, margins, and key business decisions.


What you need to know about this position:



As a Senior Analyst – CS&L and External Manufacturing, you will be responsible for ensuring financial compliance, managing operational budgets, and supporting key decision-making for our plant operations.


This role is to maintaining financial discipline and driving efficiency across external manufacturing operations.


What extra ingredients you will bring:



1. Plant Compliance & Financial Control


Ensure internal controls and compliance across plant operations.


Manage monthly financial book closures with accuracy and timeliness.



2. Budget Management (Forecasting & Decision Support)


Prepare, finalize, and upload the annual plant budgets into SAP systems.


Monitor budgetary performance and ensure alignment with financial goals.


Analyze actuals vs plan/forecast and highlight key variances
Provide structured insights on cost performance and efficiency levers
Ensure strong financial rigor in monthly and quarterly performance reviews


3. Factory & Cross-functional Collaboration
Work closely with plant teams to identify and drive cost-saving initiatives
Support standardization, harmonization, and efficiency improvement programs
Partner with procurement, supply chain, and operations teams on cost optimization



4. General Ledger and Reconciliation


Prepare and reconcile general ledger balances to ensure accuracy in reporting.


Consolidate and review scrap losses, driving accountability across operations.



5. Cost Analysis and Reporting


Conduct detailed cost variance analyses and present findings to plant operations teams.


Monitor and review plant KPIs, prepare Management Information System (MIS) reports, and discuss actionable insights with the leadership team.



6. Audit and Taxation


Coordinate stock and fixed asset audits to ensure compliance.


Provide central support on taxation matters related to plant operations.


Education / Certifications:


  • Degree in Accounting and Finance or Professionally qualified (eg: ACCA/CMA/CPA)

Job specific requirements:



  • Minimum 5 years of accounting and analyst experience
  • SAP experience (modules: PP/Costing, COPA and FI)
  • Excel (eg: formulas like lookups, sumif, average, min, max, concatenate; pivot tables; charts)
  • Sound grasp of accounting principles and standards
  • Experience in performing closing activities, analysis and business partnering
  • Learns fast, independent, resourceful, proactive, analytical, adaptable, commercially savvy, attention to detail and drive
  • Able to work with cross functional colleagues (Accounting and External Reporting team, Regional FP&A teams, outsourcing partners, commercial colleagues) whether face to face or virtually via Microsoft Teams.
  • Demonstrated that you are willing and able to overcome challenges, adapt to/manage change and be a part of the solution
  • Finance experience in manufacturing and Sales and Service Tax (SST) is an advantage

Work schedule:


Full-Time

Headquartered in Dubai, UAE, we have more than 2600 employees working across seven plants and six commercial offices; we make, bake, sell and deliver our products to customers. We are market leaders in key snacking categories with iconic global and local brands including Cadbury Dairy Milk chocolate, Milka, Oreo and belVita biscuits, Barni Cakes,Tang powdered beverage, Chiclets and Trident gum and Halls candy.

title: Project Manager
description:
Are you an experienced construction professional looking to lead challenging projects and make a direct impact on a growing company? Do you thrive in a fast-paced environment where organization, leadership, and problem-solving drive success?


A Team Pacific Roofing, Inc. is seeking an experienced Project Manager to oversee commercial roofing projects from pre-construction through closeout. This role offers the opportunity to manage a diverse portfolio of projects while working alongside a team dedicated to quality, safety, and exceptional customer service.


Location Requirement

No relocation assistance is provided for this position. Applicants must currently reside on the island or be prepared to relocate at their own expense.


Position Overview

The Project Manager is responsible for planning, coordinating, and managing multiple commercial roofing projects while ensuring projects are completed safely, on schedule, within budget, and in accordance with contract requirements.

This position requires a strong leader who can effectively manage customers, subcontractors, suppliers, field personnel, and internal resources while maintaining the highest standards of quality and professionalism.

The successful candidate will leverage technology, communication, and project management best practices to maintain project performance and deliver exceptional results to our clients.


Responsibilities

Responsibilities include, but are not limited to:

  • Manage multiple commercial roofing projects simultaneously from award through completion
  • Develop and maintain project schedules, budgets, and resource plans
  • Review contracts, drawings, specifications, submittals, and project documentation
  • Coordinate labor, equipment, materials, subcontractors, and logistics
  • Monitor project performance, costs, productivity, and profitability
  • Communicate regularly with clients, consultants, vendors, subcontractors, and internal teams
  • Identify and resolve project challenges before they impact schedules or budgets
  • Prepare and manage RFIs, submittals, change orders, purchase orders, and project correspondence
  • Lead project meetings and maintain accurate project records
  • Ensure compliance with company policies, contract requirements, and safety standards
  • Support superintendents, foremen, and field personnel with project execution
  • Track material procurement, deliveries, and inventory requirements
  • Maintain a high level of customer satisfaction throughout the life of each project
  • Assist with project closeout documentation and warranty requirements
  • Promote and maintain a strong team-oriented culture


Qualifications

Required

  • Minimum 3 years of recent, verifiable Project Management experience
  • Experience managing commercial construction projects
  • Valid driver's license and acceptable driving record
  • Reliable transportation
  • Strong organizational and time-management skills
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment
  • Strong problem-solving and decision-making abilities
  • Willingness to work the hours necessary to successfully manage projects


Preferred

  • Commercial roofing experience, including new construction and reroofing projects
  • Experience reviewing construction plans, specifications, and technical documents
  • Proficiency with:
    • Microsoft Office Suite
    • AutoCAD
    • PC Draft
    • Bluebeam Revu
  • Experience with construction management software and project tracking systems
  • Knowledge of military, government, or federal construction projects


Military Installation Access

title: Electrical Technician | Al-Futtaim Automotive - BYD | KSA
description:
Position Summary

The Electrical Technician is the workshop’s specialist in vehicle electrical, electronic, and high-voltage systems, supporting advanced diagnostics and repair across conventional, hybrid, and fully electric vehicles.

The role is responsible for resolving complex electrical faults, performing ECU programming and software updates, and executing ADAS calibration and system configuration in line with OEM standards. As dealerships transition toward electrified and software-driven vehicles, this position plays a critical role in ensuring diagnostic accuracy, repair quality, and safe handling of high-voltage systems.

The Electrical Technician also supports workshop capability by assisting general Technicians with complex cases and contributing to technical knowledge development across the team.

Key Responsibilities

Advanced Electrical Diagnostics

• Diagnose and repair complex electrical and electronic faults including CAN bus systems, body control modules, infotainment systems, and powertrain electronics

• Perform advanced fault tracing using OEM diagnostic tools, scan platforms, and electrical testing equipment

• Execute ECU flashing, software updates, and control module programming in line with manufacturer guidelines

• Carry out ADAS calibration, sensor alignment, key coding, and immobilizer programming where required

EV & Hybrid Systems

• Perform diagnostics, service, and repair of high-voltage (HV) systems in electric and hybrid vehicles

• Conduct battery health checks, isolation testing, and inspection of inverters, electric motors, and HV wiring systems

• Ensure correct handling, storage, and maintenance of HV batteries and related components

• Maintain and calibrate HV diagnostic tools including insulation testers, milliohm meters, and specialized equipment

Quality, Safety & Compliance

• Follow strict high-voltage safety procedures including lockout/tagout protocols, system isolation, and PPE usage

• Ensure all repairs are completed using OEM-approved methods, tools, and safety standards

• Accurately document diagnostic steps, fault codes, test results, and repair actions in the Dealer Management System (DMS) and OEM warranty portals

• Support compliance with OEM technical standards, audit requirements, and dealership operating procedures

Technical Support & Team Development

• Provide technical support to general Technicians and Workshop Supervisors on complex electrical and electronic issues

• Escalate unresolved cases to Technical Support Engineers or OEM technical helplines when required

• Share technical knowledge, best practices, and learnings with the workshop team to improve overall capability

• Contribute to internal technical updates, bulletins, and on-the-job coaching for junior technicians

Skills

Educational Requirements

• Diploma or Bachelor’s Degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, Automotive Engineering, or a related discipline

• OEM certifications in electrical diagnostics, EV systems, or high-voltage safety are highly preferred

Experience Requirements

• Minimum 4–6 years of experience as an Automotive Technician with a strong specialization in electrical and electronic systems

• Proven experience handling complex diagnostics, ECU programming, and advanced electronic fault resolution

• Hands-on experience with EV, hybrid, or plug-in hybrid vehicles is strongly preferred

Technical Skills

• Expert-level proficiency in OEM diagnostic tools and scan platforms.

• Strong understanding of vehicle communication networks including CAN, LIN, and Ethernet systems

• Ability to read and interpret advanced electrical wiring diagrams and technical schematics

• Experience using ADAS calibration equipment, key programming tools, and oscilloscope-based diagnostics

• Working knowledge of DMS platforms, warranty systems, and OEM technical reference portals

• Familiarity with EV/HV systems, battery management systems, and safety protocols

title: Mission Protection Systems Engineer (OSS-INT)
description:
Overview

Stellar Solutions, a nationally recognized “Great Place To Work”, has exciting opportunities providing Engineering solutions for innovative new-entrant space companies, as well as established space systems manufacturers, commercial space system operators and service providers, and other industry stakeholders including investors.

At Stellar Solutions, we offer talented, energetic, and immediately productive resources to satisfy our customers’ critical needs in systems engineering and integration, mission operations, program management and strategic planning. We are a leading service and expertise provider for high-tech commercial ventures, spanning communications, earth observation and remote sensing systems and data products, to the infrastructures that support earth orbiting and beyond earth orbit businesses.

Role/Responsibilities/Qualifications

Stellar Solutions has an opportunity for a Systems Engineer located in Northern Virginia to provide Systems Engineering and Technical Advisory (SETA) services focused on protection of mission systems. This position supports the customer by understanding the current and emerging threats; develops threat mitigation tactics, techniques and procedures; facilitates training and exercises and provides on-site mission protection support

The successful candidate will:

  • Work as ops planning and protection SME; synchronizing priorities and activities through frequent interactions with the GPOC, the command and control and mission protection teams and key operations teams across the Enterprise
  • Plan and organize involvement in internal and external exercises, and when necessary, wargames
  • Capture lessons learned to improve space operations and protection efforts
  • Collaborate with internal and external partners to equip operators and leaders to make decisions on protection related actions
  • Collaborate with external SMEs to understand current and emerging threat environment
  • Identify and capture risks, issues and opportunities for the customer and provide analysis and recommendations
  • Produce and review and comment on documents related to new capabilities, concepts and integration efforts

Required Qualifications:

  • Must be a US Citizen
  • Active TS/SCI clearance with CI polygraph, and DOD SAP eligibility
  • Bachelor’s degree and five (5) years or more relevant experience
  • Knowledge of satellite constellations, spacecraft orbit, and ground station characteristics
  • Understands satellite operations and satellite components (bus and payload), RF Fundamentals and associated ground systems and approaches to assessing vulnerabilities
  • Self-starter, reputation for successfully anticipating and proactively addressing customer requirements with minimal supervision; ability to manage multiple tasks and deliverables
  • Effective communicator (written/verbal) with sound interpersonal skills and judgment; master at collaboration and coordination with multiple stakeholders
  • Ability to work independently and with a team of contractors, SETA, FFRDC, and Government
  • Support meetings during non-standard duty hours as required

Desired Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in science, technology, engineering, or mathematics (STEM) or relevant field and nine (9) years or more relevant experience; Master in STEM or relevant field and seven (7) years of more relevant experience
  • Experience using JP 5-0, Joint Planning, principles and/or products at the tactical and/or operational levels
  • USAF Space Test School Graduate (or similar experience planning and assessing tactics, techniques and procedures (TTPs) against threat representative systems
  • Experience as a spacecraft or ground systems operator
  • Experience planning and operating against threats to spacecraft and/or other mission systems in real-world and/or mod/sim software
  • Experience assessing counterspace threats (on-orbit, ground, cyber)
  • Experience applying orbital mechanics to a dynamic orbital scenario
  • Familiarity with various Systems Engineering and Program Management principles and constructs (Digital Engineering, Model-based Systems Engineering (MBSE), AGILE Development, etc)
  • Experience with Jira and Confluence

In addition to base salary, this position is eligible for a comprehensive total rewards package that includes an annual performance bonus, an employer-funded Profit-Sharing Plan (PSP) contribution based on base compensation, and comprehensive employer-paid medical benefits, PTO pay-out options, along with additional company-sponsored benefits. All of these benefits represent an additional 30-40% to your base compensation for a total compensation package.

Deliverable(s)

Deliverables will be in the format of reports, briefings, spreadsheets, or other documents as directed by the Government. The nature of the work will, at times, require a quick response to stringent deadlines and always in a high quality, professional manner.

title: Newborn Photographer-Charleston

title: Administrative Executive
description:
Overview Of The Role:


  • The Admin Assistant role is crucial in providing structured administrative, coordination, and support functions across RSD facilities and project activities within KSA. This position involves maintaining accurate records and trackers, supporting procurement processes, and monitoring contracts and statutory renewals. The role is essential for ensuring effective follow-up in store openings, closures, and handovers, working closely with various teams including the Country RSD Manager, Facilities Supervisors, Project teams, Store Operations, Procurement, Finance, vendors, service providers, and mall management. Success in this role requires high attention to detail, confidentiality, time management, and the ability to manage multiple priorities.


What You Will Do:


Planning, PPM and Reactive Maintenance


  • Maintain the annual Planned Preventive Maintenance (PPM) schedule in line with approved facilities contracts and monitor completion status.
  • Manage reactive maintenance (RM) and job-order trackers based on store requirements and priorities.
  • Coordinate work permits and access with stores, malls, and service providers.
  • Collect completion reports and confirmations before processing service completion and payment documentation.


Tracking, Monitoring and Document Control


  • Maintain up-to-date trackers for job orders, cost proposals, and attendance records.
  • Organize electronic filing and document-control system for quotations, approvals, POs, invoices, reports, permits, contracts, and correspondence.
  • Follow up with Facilities Supervisors, stores, and vendors to close outstanding documentation.
  • Ensure data accuracy, version control, confidentiality, and retrieval of records.


Procurement and Vendor Coordination


  • Support vendor registration and prequalification by tracking required documents.
  • Coordinate requests for quotations and procurement documentation.
  • Prepare and track purchase requisitions and follow up until issuance.
  • Track vendor invoices, payment status, and resolve documentation gaps with Finance and vendors.


Contract and Service Provider Administration


  • Maintain a contract and AMC register covering scope, vendor, value, and renewal date.
  • Monitor contract expiry dates and coordinate renewal documentation.
  • Collect monthly attendance sheets and service reports in accordance with service-provider contracts.
  • Coordinate third-party vendors for site surveys, quotations, and scope definition where not covered under AMC.
  • Distribute and collect stakeholder satisfaction surveys and maintain logs.


Statutory Certificates, Permits and Compliance Tracking


  • Maintain Civil Defence, Trading License, permit, and other statutory renewal trackers.
  • Notify stakeholders of upcoming expiries and ensure renewal evidence is filed.
  • Maintain approved vendor compliance documents.


Projects, Store Openings, Relocations and Closures


  • Provide administrative support for store openings, closures, and handovers.
  • Maintain project and handover trackers, document registers, and close-out records.
  • Coordinate documentation with mall management, stores, and contractors.
  • Collect and archive approved drawings, warranties, and completion certificates.


Finance, Budget and Asset Administration


  • Maintain monthly spend trackers against annual budgets.
  • Support annual budget preparation through historical spend records.
  • Support asset registration, transfer, and disposal documentation.
  • Reconcile PO, invoice, completion, and payment records.


Reporting and Performance Dashboards


  • Prepare weekly and monthly management reports on facilities activities.
  • Maintain dashboards and action trackers with target dates and status.
  • Highlight overdue actions, budget variances, and operational risks.


Skills

Required Skills To Be Successful:


  • Document control and tender coordination experience.
  • Strong communication skills in both Arabic and English.
  • Excellent time management and organizational abilities.
  • Technical awareness and problem-solving skills in related tasks.


What Qualifies You For The Role:


  • Diploma or Bachelor's degree in Business Administration or related discipline.
  • 3-5 years of relevant experience in facilities administration, procurement coordination, contract administration, or project administration, preferably within retail or multi-site operations in KSA.
  • Strong MS Office skills, particularly in Excel, Word, PowerPoint, and Outlook.
  • Fluency in written and verbal Arabic and English with the ability to coordinate professionally with internal and external stakeholders.

title: Behavioral Rehabilitation Specilist
description:
QUALIFIED RESIDENTIAL TREATMENT PROGRAM (QRTP ONLY)

Bamboo Sunrise, LLC | Henderson / Las Vegas, Nevada


Make a Difference in the Lives of At-Risk Youth

Work directly with youth in a structured home setting using a trauma-informed approach.
Build extensive knowledge of mental and behavioral health needs.
Receive ongoing monthly psychosocial training to strengthen your skills and capacity.

Bamboo Sunrise is seeking dedicated, compassionate, and trauma-informed Behavioral Support Specialists to join our QRTP team. Our youth come from diverse backgrounds and may present with complex behavioral, emotional, and mental health needs. Successful candidates must demonstrate professionalism, flexibility, sound judgment, strong communication, and a commitment to youth safety and quality care.


Important Applicant Requirements


PLEASE READ ALL REQUIREMENTS BEFORE APPLYING.


Required Background Clearances

FBI Criminal History Background Check
Adam Walsh Child Protection and Safety Check
Child Abuse and Neglect Screening (CANS) through the Department of Family Services
Department of Family Services (DFS) county background and reference check


Applicant-Paid Pre-Employment Costs

Background check and clearance costs are not reimbursed.
Nevada resident fingerprinting/background fees begin at $45.
Applicants relocating from out of state may have additional fees.
Required items may include TB testing, CPR certification, and internal agency testing before beginning work.

Background and Drug-Screening Notice

Applicants with arrests or criminal history within the previous seven years may be ineligible depending on the nature of the offense and applicable DFS clearance requirements. This includes, but is not limited to, matters involving DUI, child protective services, or domestic violence. Final eligibility is determined through the required background clearance process.


Bamboo Sunrise maintains a drug-free workplace and conducts random drug testing, including marijuana testing. No exceptions.


Position Overview

Behavioral Support Specialists provide direct supervision, skill-building interventions, crisis support, and behavioral coaching to youth residing in the QRTP program. Staff work as part of a multidisciplinary treatment team focused on safety, stabilization, emotional regulation, independent living skills, social skills, and healthy coping strategies.


Primary Responsibilities

Provide one-to-one skills teaching and direct support in home and community settings.
Implement interventions designed to improve basic living skills, social skills, interpersonal functioning, communication, and family functioning.
Work with youth and families using psychoeducational, behavior-modification, and insight-oriented approaches consistent with the youth’s plan of care.
Provide trauma-informed supervision, mentoring, structure, and positive behavioral support.
Support youth during emotional or behavioral crises and follow agency crisis-response procedures.
Assist with transportation, appointments, community integration, and recreational programming as assigned.
Complete accurate, timely, clear, and concise documentation of client interactions.
Use clinical terminology appropriately and maintain confidentiality in accordance with agency policy and applicable privacy requirements.
Attend monthly supervision and all required training.
Communicate professionally with supervisors and treatment-team members.
Follow all agency policies, child welfare requirements, safety procedures, and professional boundaries.
Provide after-hours crisis intervention when assigned.


Required Schedule and Availability


Evening and Weekend Availability Is Required


Weekday evening shift: 2:00 PM to 10:30 PM
Weekend day shift: 6:00 AM to 2:30 PM
Weekend evening shift: 2:00 PM to 10:30 PM
Qualified staff who meet performance and service expectations may receive approximately 40+ hours per week.

Minimum Position Requirements

  • Must be able and willing to work required evening and weekend shifts.
  • Computer and software proficiency.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to multitask and work effectively with diverse individuals.
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced environment and respond appropriately during crises.
  • General understanding of trauma-informed practices; agency training is provided.
  • Flexibility, reliability, sound judgment, and professional conduct.
  • Reliable vehicle and current automobile insurance in the applicant’s name or coverage as a designated driver.
  • Valid Nevada Driver’s License.
  • Must be 25 years of age or older.
  • Ability to attend required training at the Bamboo Sunrise main office.
  • Education and Professional Work Experience Requirements


We require you to have one of the following bachelor’s degree with at least 2 years of experience working with children.

  • Psychology
  • Social Work
  • Anthropology
  • Sociology
  • Human Development and Family Studies
  • Nursing
  • Community Health Sciences or Health Ecology
  • Early Childhood Education
  • Education
  • Criminal Justice
  • Public Health


Preferred Qualifications

  • Social services experience
  • ABA or RBT background
  • Experience in child welfare, residential treatment, foster care, behavioral health, or crisis intervention
  • Familiarity with clinical terminology and HIPAA-related policies
  • Experience completing professional service documentation


What We Offer

  • Anthem BCBS PPO Full Coverage for Employee
  • UHC Dental and Vision
  • PTO After 90 Days
  • Monthly psychosocial and behavioral health training
  • Hands-on experience supporting youth with complex needs
  • Supportive supervision and professional development
  • Meaningful work focused on youth safety, stabilization, and growth
  • Opportunities for advancement within the organization


Join Our Mission

At Bamboo Sunrise, we believe every youth deserves safety, stability, respect, and the opportunity to heal. If you are prepared to provide consistent, trauma-informed support in a challenging and rewarding residential environment, we encourage you to apply.


Equal Employment Opportunity

Bamboo Sunrise, LLC is an Equal Opportunity Employer committed to a professional, inclusive, and trauma-informed workplace.

title: Community Engagement and Outreach Manager
description:
About Us: Building One Community (B1C) is a Stamford, Connecticut-based nonprofit supporting the successful integration of immigrants and their families. At B1C, immigrants acquire the tools they need to thrive. We provide free services that educate, employ, empower and engage immigrants and the broader community. Our programs include English Language classes, Family and Individual Support Services, Academic Enrichment Programs, Immigration Legal Services, and Workforce Development programs.


Position: The Community Engagement and Outreach Manager plays a key role in building and maintaining relationships that strengthen Building One Community (B1C)'s programs, services, and resources for immigrant individuals and families throughout Fairfield County. Reporting to the Associate Director of Family Services, this part-time position begins at 20 hours per week, with the potential to increase to up to 25 hours per week based on organizational needs. The Manager develops strong, trust-based relationships with community organizations, service providers, schools, faith communities, businesses, consulates, and other institutions. The Manager serves as a liaison between B1C and external partners to strengthen referral pathways, develop collaborative opportunities, and expand access to resources and services. The Manager also supervises the Outreach Coordinator, providing guidance and support to ensure outreach efforts align with broader community partnership priorities.

The Manager will also identify and coordinate resources, including in-kind goods and services and other community support that benefit B1C participants and programs. The position works closely with B1C Program, Communications, and Development teams to align community partnerships and resources with organizational and program priorities.

The position has a flexible schedule that may include weekdays, evenings, and weekends based on partner meetings, events, and organizational needs, with time spent in the community, in the field, or at the B1C office for partner communication, planning, follow-up, data tracking, reporting, and administrative responsibilities.


Primary Duties:

  • Build and maintain strong, trust-based relationships with community organizations, service providers, schools, faith communities, businesses, consulates, and other institutions that serve or support immigrant communities.
  • Serve as a liaison between B1C and external organizations, strengthening referral pathways, facilitating connections, and developing collaborative opportunities.
  • Conduct direct outreach and engagement in the field alongside the Outreach Coordinator, including grassroots outreach, tabling, and community events, to raise awareness of B1C, support participant recruitment and engagement, and maintain a consistent presence in priority communities.
  • Represent B1C as a visible ambassador at partner meetings, community fairs, coalitions, and other gatherings, and deliver presentations to partners and community groups.
  • Partner with B1C program teams to understand priorities and upcoming initiatives, and identify relevant community initiatives, programs, services, and coalitions that expand opportunities for participants and programs.
  • Gather participant and community feedback through conversations, surveys, and outreach activities, and identify emerging needs, service gaps, and barriers, sharing insights with B1C program teams.
  • Coordinate collaborative events, workshops, health initiatives, tabling, and other activities with B1C partners and service providers, and support the planning and execution of major B1C organizational events and community engagement initiatives.
  • Coordinate in-kind donations and other community resources, working with the Development team, Family Services, and other departments to cultivate donor relationships, community support, and donation distribution events.
  • Supervise the Outreach Coordinator, providing guidance and support to ensure outreach aligns with broader community partnership efforts.
  • Maintain an up-to-date database of community partners, referral resources, partnership and outreach activities, participant feedback, and outcomes in Salesforce or other appropriate systems.

Qualifications & Skills

  • Fluency in Spanish and English with demonstrated written and verbal communication skills required.
  • Bachelor's degree in Nonprofit Management, Community Development, Human Services, or a related field preferred; equivalent experience may be considered.
  • Minimum of three to five years of experience in community partnerships, outreach, or nonprofit work, including supervisory experience.
  • Experience working effectively with individuals and families from diverse cultural, linguistic, and socioeconomic backgrounds.
  • Experience tracking partnership activities and outcomes; Salesforce knowledge a plus.
  • Excellent organizational, problem-solving, and communication skills, including public and community presentations.
  • Ability to build and maintain relationships with a wide range of community organizations and stakeholders.
  • Comfortable working independently and representing B1C publicly.
  • Reliable transportation required for travel to community sites and events.
  • Availability to work some evenings and weekends as needed.
  • Commitment to B1C's mission, values, and goals


Compensation & Benefits

B1C offers a competitive salary commensurate with experience, along with a comprehensive benefits package. B1C is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a diverse and inclusive team that reflects the community we serve.

Benefits include medical, dental and vision insurance, employer-sponsored life insurance, 401(k) with employer contribution, paid time off, paid holidays and other company-sponsored benefits.

Building One Community is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

title: QA-QC Manager
description:
Overview

GrayWolf is a heavy industrial/commercial construction contractor that provides end-to-end solutions from design, fabrication, construction, and facility management with a footprint that is nationwide. With more than 45-years of experience in the industry, we have strong leadership and support teams who understand field servant leadership is the key to our success. We are continually

BUILDING new talent while developing our current talent. As our assignments vary in duration and locations, we provide a safe and ethical environment and offer a competitive wage and benefit program. Candidate must possess a strong background in the development, implementation, and understanding of ASME Welding Procedures (WPS) and Welder Performance Qualifications (WPQ).

description:

title: Director, Training
description:
Overview

The Director, Training is responsible for the design, delivery, and governance of L5's training and qualification programs for critical operations across commissioning, facilities management operations, and project management retrofit service lines. This role ensures that every technician, engineer, and operations leader is trained, qualified, and proven competent before working on or operating live mission critical systems. The Director will build a scalable, standards-based training platform that reduces operational risk, protects uptime, and meets the expectations of L5's hyperscale, enterprise, colocation, Neocloud/AI, and Edge clients. It is a highly cross-functional role, partnering closely with operations, safety, human resources and talent acquisition, commissioning, project delivery, and executive leadership.

Responsibilities

Critical Operations Training

  • Design and deliver training for the operation and maintenance of critical power, cooling, and building systems, including electrical distribution, UPS and battery systems, generators, chillers, and controls.
  • Build training around methods of procedure (MOPs), standard and emergency operating procedures (SOPs/EOPs), change management, and abnormal and emergency response.
  • Develop scenario-based drills and simulations that prepare teams to respond to alarms, failures, and incidents in live environments without risk to uptime.
  • Embed safety and compliance training, including electrical safety, lockout/tagout, work permitting, and site access protocols, into every operational program.
  • Provide role-specific training for commissioning and project management & retrofit teams, covering test procedures, integrated systems testing, and work in live or occupied facilities.

Qualification & Competency Management

  • Establish tiered qualification pathways and competency standards for each critical operations role, from entry-level technician through site leadership.
  • Implement skills assessments, field sign-offs, and certification requirements that verify competence before personnel are authorized to perform critical work.
  • Align L5 training with client-specific requirements, site-specific procedures, and industry standards and certifications.
  • Maintain training records and audit-ready documentation to support client audits, safety reviews, and contractual obligations.

Program Build & Delivery

  • Build and lead a training team of instructors, curriculum developers, and site-based trainers scaled to L5’s
  • growth.
  • Select and implement the learning management system (LMS) and training tools, including simulation, virtual, and hands-on training environments.
  • Create onboarding programs that bring new hires up to site-ready standards quickly and consistently.
  • Partner with talent acquisition on apprenticeships, school programs, and military transition pipelines to develop the next generation of critical operations talent.
  • Develop supervisors and site leaders in operational discipline, communication, and incident leadership.

Leadership & Process

  • Define a training strategy tied to L5’s growth plan, new site mobilizations, and client commitments.
  • Track and report training completion, qualification status, assessment results, and incident and near-miss trends to measure program effectiveness.
  • Use incident reviews, audit findings, and lessons learned to continuously improve content and close skill gaps.
  • Serve as a key advisor to executive leadership on workforce readiness, operational risk, and capability development.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Operations, Business, Education, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
  • 10+ years of experience in mission critical operations, data center operations, facilities management, or a related technical environment, including 5+ years leading training, qualification, or technical development programs.
  • Deep working knowledge of critical power and cooling infrastructure and the procedures used to operate and maintain it in live environments.
  • Demonstrated success building training and qualification programs from scratch or scaling them in a growing organization.
  • Experience developing competency-based training, including scenario-based drills, simulations, and field assessments.
  • Strong understanding of safety and compliance standards for electrical and mechanical work, such as NFPA 70E and OSHA requirements.
  • Experience with learning management systems and training analytics.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to engage technicians in the field and executives in the boardroom.
  • Proven ability to lead cross-functional teams and influence operations leaders across multiple sites.
  • Occasional travel to sites, clients, and training events across North America.
  • Experience with hyperscale, colocation, or enterprise data center clients preferred.
  • Industry certifications, such as Uptime Institute, CDCP, or CDFOM, or instructional design credentials preferred.
  • Experience with commissioning or construction and retrofit environments preferred.

What Success Looks Like

  • A repeatable, scalable training and qualification program that supports L5’s national growth.
  • Every person working on critical systems is qualified, current, and audit-ready.
  • Faster time to site-ready for new hires, with fewer operational incidents and near misses.
  • Strong, trusted working relationships across operations, safety, human resources, and executive leadership.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local law.

title: RidgeWalker
description:
ANASAZI FOUNDATION

Mesa, Arizona

JOB DESCRIPTION

Job Title: Back-Up / RidgeWalker
Department: Field Operations
Reports To: Field Leadership
FLSA Status: Non-Exempt
Date Revised: September 2026

Position Summary

The Back-Up / RidgeWalker is an experienced field staff member responsible for providing leadership, safety oversight, navigation, transportation, emergency response, and logistical support within ANASAZI Foundation’s Outdoor Behavioral Health Care Program.

This position supports TrailWalkers and YoungWalkers in remote outdoor environments and helps ensure safe, effective, and consistent field operations. The Back-Up / RidgeWalker does not independently provide psychotherapy, diagnosis, treatment planning, or nursing services.

Essential Duties & Responsibilities

  • Provide field leadership, guidance, and support to TrailWalkers and YoungWalkers.
  • Assist with continuous protective oversight and client safety in remote outdoor environments.
  • Navigate using maps, GPS, established routes, and other approved navigation resources.
  • Monitor weather, terrain, water availability, environmental hazards, staffing, supplies, and other conditions affecting field safety.
  • Safely operate ANASAZI vehicles on paved, unpaved, and rugged roads, including four-wheel-drive vehicles when assigned.
  • Support client treatment goals established by the clinical team while maintaining appropriate behavioral health role boundaries.
  • Assist staff with behavioral concerns, conflict resolution, de-escalation, and crisis situations.
  • Respond appropriately to emergencies, client elopement, medical concerns, evacuations, transportation needs, and other significant field events.
  • Provide first aid, emergency assistance, or medication support only when appropriately trained, authorized, and permitted.
  • Maintain and monitor field communication equipment, emergency supplies, vehicles, food, water, and other assigned resources.
  • Coordinate field resupply, transportation, staff movement, and other logistical needs as assigned.
  • Maintain timely and accurate field documentation and incident reporting.
  • Promptly communicate significant client, staff, medical, behavioral, safety, or environmental concerns to appropriate personnel.
  • Maintain professional boundaries, confidentiality, client rights, and mandatory-reporting requirements.
  • Participate in required training, meetings, competency assessments, emergency preparedness, and quality-improvement activities.

Minimum Qualifications

Education

  • High school diploma or GED required.

Experience

  • Minimum of six months of relevant ANASAZI field experience or comparable direct-care/outdoor program experience required.
  • Experience with youth, behavioral health, outdoor programming, field leadership, or emergency response preferred.

Licensure / Certifications

  • Valid driver’s license and satisfactory driving eligibility/insurance requirements for assigned vehicle operation.
  • Current CPR and First Aid certification.
  • Arizona Fingerprint Clearance Card as required by applicable law and ANASAZI policy.
  • Wilderness First Aid (WFA), Wilderness First Responder (WFR), EMT, or other advanced first-aid certification as required for assigned responsibilities.
  • Required ANASAZI field, safety, emergency-response, driver, and competency training.
  • Previous four-wheel-drive or off-road driving experience preferred; ability to learn and demonstrate safe operation required when assigned.

ANASAZI will verify required education, experience, credentials, qualifications, driving eligibility, and competencies in accordance with applicable requirements.

Required Competencies

  • Field leadership and client supervision
  • Outdoor safety and risk awareness
  • Navigation, route planning, and environmental assessment
  • Four-wheel-drive and vehicle safety when assigned
  • Behavioral support, de-escalation, and crisis response
  • Emergency response, evacuation, and elopement procedures
  • First aid and medication support when trained and authorized
  • Field communication systems and emergency equipment
  • Documentation and incident reporting
  • Client rights, confidentiality, professional boundaries, and mandatory reporting
  • ANASAZI philosophy, outdoor education, and field practices
  • Sound judgment, reliability, communication, teamwork, and leadership

Competency will be assessed and documented according to ANASAZI policy and applicable regulatory, licensing, and accreditation requirements.

Physical & Environmental Essential Functions

This position requires the ability to:

  • Hike approximately 3–15 miles per day over rugged, uneven, and remote terrain.
  • Carry a backpack weighing approximately 50 pounds or more for extended periods, including personal food, clothing, belongings, and assigned emergency or field equipment.
  • Stand, walk, climb, bend, kneel, lift, carry, and perform physically demanding activities for extended periods.
  • Participate in multi-day and overnight outdoor assignments.
  • Function safely in varying temperatures, weather conditions, terrain, and elevations.
  • Maintain sufficient mobility and environmental awareness to respond to client and field-safety needs.

Qualified individuals must be able to perform the essential functions with or without reasonable accommodation, consistent with applicable law.

Working Conditions & Schedule

Work is primarily performed in remote outdoor environments and may include multi-day and overnight assignments, weekends, holidays, irregular hours, and emergency response.

Employees may be exposed to extreme temperatures, changing weather, rugged terrain, insects, wildlife, off-road travel, behavioral crises, and other conditions inherent to outdoor field operations.

Compliance & Professional Expectations

The Back-Up / RidgeWalker must comply with applicable federal and Arizona requirements, AZDHS requirements, applicable Joint Commission standards, ANASAZI safety and field policies, client rights, confidentiality, mandatory-reporting requirements, and organizational procedures.

The employee may perform only those direct-care, emergency, medication-support, transportation, or other duties for which the employee has been appropriately trained, determined competent, and authorized.

The Back-Up / RidgeWalker supports implementation of the client’s established treatment plan but does not independently diagnose, provide psychotherapy, develop or modify clinical treatment plans, or perform nursing services unless separately qualified and authorized to do so.

Other Duties

This description identifies the position’s primary responsibilities and essential functions and is not exhaustive. Other duties may be assigned when consistent with the position, employee competency, and applicable requirements.

title: Workshop Manager | Al-Futtaim Automotive - BYD | KSA
description:
Position Summary

The Workshop Manager is responsible for leading end-to-end workshop operations within the Aftersales function, ensuring service excellence, technical quality, productivity, and profitability across all repair and maintenance activities.

The role acts as the operational backbone of the service center, driving labour utilisation, efficiency, and revenue performance while ensuring full compliance with OEM standards and dealership KPIs. The Workshop Manager directly impacts customer satisfaction (NPS/CSI), Fix-Right-First-Time (FRFT) performance, warranty governance, and overall aftersales commercial success.

By leading workshop teams, controlling operational costs, and ensuring high-quality service delivery, the role plays a critical part in maintaining dealership reputation and achieving sustainable business growth.

Key Responsibilities

Workshop Operations & Productivity

• Lead daily workshop operations to achieve labour sales, productivity, efficiency, and utilisation targets aligned with brand KPIs

• Manage workload distribution, bay allocation, technician capacity, and job progression to maximise throughput and minimise vehicle turnaround time

• Drive Fix-Right-First-Time (FRFT) performance and reduce repeat repairs and comebacks through strong technical governance

• Ensure adherence to OEM repair standards, service bulletins, diagnostic procedures, and workshop processes

• Monitor work-in-progress (WIP) and control ageing Repair Orders to ensure timely completion and revenue realisation

Financial & Commercial Performance

• Deliver workshop revenue, labour sales, and gross profit targets across mechanical, electrical, body & paint, and accessory operations

• Drive revenue growth through Vehicle Health Checks (VHC), menu pricing, and upselling opportunities via Service Advisors

• Control operational costs including consumables, overtime, sublet expenses, and warranty rework within approved budgets

• Analyse financial performance and implement corrective actions to improve profitability and cost efficiency

Customer Experience & Service Quality

title: Environmental Engineering Intern
description:
Subsidiary

SDI Biocarbon Solutions

Overview

What Does Steel Dynamics Do?

Steel Dynamics is a leading industrial metals solutions company that produces lower-carbon, high-quality steel products primarily from recycled scrap. Operating through a circular manufacturing model, the company manufactures a wide range of steel products including flat roll, structural, and long products for industries such as construction, automotive, energy, and manufacturing. In addition to steel production, Steel Dynamics operates metals recycling facilities, steel fabrication plants, and aluminum production operations, serving customers across North America with a focus on innovation, efficiency, and sustainability.

What Makes This Internship Different?

This Environmental Engineering Internship differs from typical programs because it is embedded in an active manufacturing environment where work informs real operational and sustainability decisions. Interns build direct relationships with operations, corporate leaders, and external partners, gaining a clear view of how environmental engineering supports business goals and community expectations. The experience emphasizes mentorship, data driven problem solving, and visible outcomes, creating a faster learning curve and a stronger professional network than many classroom style or observational internships.

Internship Location

This internship is located at the Steel Dynamics BioCarbon Solutions, located in Columbus, MS. This internship will take place during the Summer 2027 term.

Internship Benefits

  • Furnished Housing Free of Cost
    • Provided for interns living more than 50 miles from their work site, including essential furnishings to ensure a comfortable stay during the internship.
  • 401(k) & Company Match
    • Eligibility to participate in the company 401(k) plan with a 10–50% company match that vests immediately.
  • Employee Discounts
    • Access to discounts on hotels, vehicles, and other goods and services through Steel Dynamics’ nationwide partner network.
  • Employee Assistance Program
    • Up to five free visits per issue, per year for counseling, legal advice, financial guidance, and other daily living resources.
  • Intern Extravaganza
    • A two-day event at company headquarters featuring facility tours, networking with company leaders, cultural immersion, and connecting with other interns from across the country.
  • Competitive Pay
    • Competitive hourly wages for all internship positions, rewarding the value interns bring to the company.

Responsibilities

What Are My Responsibilities as an Environmental Engineering Intern at SDI BioCarbon Solutions?

  • Assist with environmental permitting by gathering data, drafting submittals, coordinating with consultants, and communicating with regulatory agencies.
  • Collect, validate, and analyze environmental data for emissions, water quality, and waste streams, and build tracking tools and reports to demonstrate compliance with permit limits.
  • Conduct field inspections of emission points, stormwater controls, waste accumulation areas, and radiation detection portals, document findings, and follow up on corrective actions.
  • Perform sampling and monitoring to verify compliance with permit conditions, maintain chain of custody, and organize sampling records.
  • Prepare or assist with required regulatory reports including emission inventories, Title V reports, SARA and Tier II submissions, deviation logs, discharge monitoring reports, and routine quarterly and annual filings.
  • Participate in root cause analyses for exceedances or abnormal trends and help develop corrective and preventive actions with operations and maintenance teams.
  • Support operation and performance tracking of pollution control equipment such as baghouses, scrubbers, and oxidizers, and recommend improvements where appropriate.
  • Contribute to sustainability and decarbonization initiatives focused on emissions reduction, waste minimization, water stewardship, and recycling.
  • Assist with contractor and vendor coordination, waste profiling and manifests, and value driven procurement to meet program goals.
  • Help prepare for audits and inspections by organizing documentation, participating in walk throughs, and supporting responses to findings or Notices of Violation.
  • Develop and deliver basic training or job aids for environmental requirements, and partner with the SDI Corporate Office on projects as needed.

Qualifications

What Qualifications Do I Need?

  • Pursuing a bachelor’s degree in Environmental, Chemical, Biology, or other engineering fields with an environmental emphasis.
  • Clear communication and organized documentation skills to collaborate with operations and support compliance reporting.
  • Minimum of 3.0 GPA

Examples of Projects Steel Dynamics Environmental Engineering Interns Have Completed

  • Participate in hands-on environmental compliance projects by tracking air quality metrics, reviewing emission sources, and aligning operations with federal and state regulatory standards.
  • Create and manage detailed spreadsheets to monitor environmental compliance, specifically tracking sulfur dioxide (SO₂) emissions and evaluating results against EPA and IDEM limits.
  • Support the air permitting process by compiling required documentation, collaborating with third-party consultants, and maintaining communication with regulatory agencies to ensure permit accuracy and timely submissions.
  • Conduct field assessments of emission points and process areas to verify control equipment performance, identify potential non-compliance issues, and recommend corrective actions.
  • Troubleshoot instances of elevated emissions using root cause analysis and process flow reviews, working with operations teams to implement technical solutions that improve environmental performance.
  • Assist with environmental reporting by compiling and interpreting data for quarterly or annual reports, including Title V reports, emission inventories, and deviation logs.
  • Gain direct exposure to chemical processing systems such as baghouses, scrubbers, and oxidizers, learning how these systems influence emissions and process efficiency.
  • Support waste and water compliance efforts by reviewing sampling results, identifying permit exceedances, and participating in internal audits of hazardous material handling and stormwater systems.
  • Work alongside Environmental Managers to prepare for agency inspections, respond to Notice of Violations (NOVs), and implement corrective action plans.
  • Develop a strong foundation in environmental management systems (EMS), learning how data collection, documentation, and operational discipline contribute to long-term regulatory compliance and sustainable operations.

Steel Dynamics, Inc., and all affiliated entities are equal opportunity employers.

title: Senior Presentation Designer
description:
About Us

Operating at the intersection of Modern + Main Street, Doner is helping Main Street brands compete in today's marketplace and Modern brands grow by connecting with everyday people.

For nearly 90 years, Doner has created campaigns that earn relevance, influence decisions and drive measurable business impact for some of America's most iconic brands, including RAM Trucks, Meijer, Coca-Cola's fairlife and The UPS Store.

The integrated marketing agency is recognized as one of the industry's leading creative forces - bringing together strategy, creative, media, communications, commerce and production to solve today's biggest business challenges.

Overview

We’re looking for a Senior Presentation Designer to help us tell the DonerColle Partners story and, ultimately, win new business.

This role sits at the intersection of design, storytelling and business development. You’ll be responsible for creating the outward-facing materials that bring our agency, our capabilities and our work to life in ways that are clear, compelling and differentiated.

A big part of the day-to-day will be designing RFI and RFP responses, pitch presentations, credentials, case studies and other materials for our new business team. But this isn’t simply about making decks look better. It’s about understanding what we’re trying to communicate, who we’re communicating it to and finding the most powerful way to tell that story visually.

You’ll also create bespoke presentation systems and templates for individual opportunities, taking inspiration from a prospective client’s brand while making sure the work feels distinctly ours. Every assignment is different. The best ones should feel that way.

Responsibilities

What you will do:

  • Design RFI and RFP submissions, pitch decks, credentials, case studies and other new business materials.
  • Create custom presentation templates and visual systems tailored to individual clients and opportunities.
  • Help bring our agency positioning, capabilities, differentiation and work to life visually.
  • Turn complex information into presentations that are clear, intuitive and compelling.
  • Work closely with new business, strategy, creative, account leadership and senior agency leaders.
  • Quickly develop an understanding of prospective clients, their brands, categories, audiences and marketing objectives.
  • Create simple animation, motion graphics, GIFs and other visual elements that make presentations more engaging.
  • Maintain a high level of craft and consistency across everything we put in front of a prospective client.
  • Manage multiple projects, deadlines, contributors and rounds of feedback without losing track of the details.

Qualifications

What you need to succeed:

  • A strong portfolio demonstrating exceptional presentation design, visual storytelling and brand thinking.
  • Deep proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite and presentation platforms including PowerPoint, Keynote and Google Slides.
  • Experience with advanced design technology, AI and all requisite tools.
  • Experience with motion, simple animation and GIF creation.
  • A strong understanding of typography, layout, information hierarchy and visual storytelling.
  • The ability to understand a brand quickly and translate that understanding into smart, relevant design.
  • Excellent organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple assignments and deadlines at once.
  • Strong collaboration skills and comfort working with people across disciplines and levels of an organization.
  • The judgment to know when a presentation needs a big visual idea and when it simply needs to communicate something clearly.
  • A high level of attention to detail, curiosity, and resourcefulness.
  • The ability to work quickly without making the work feel rushed.

This is a new business role. The work moves fast, the audience changes constantly and the stakes are real. We’re looking for someone who likes that.

Footer

Doner is an integrated marketing agency operating at the intersection of Modern + Main Street. The agency helps brands earn relevance and influence decisions through strategy, creative, media, communications, commerce and production.

Its clients include Stellantis (Chrysler, Dodge, Jeep, Ram, FIAT and Alfa Romeo), Meijer, Coca-Cola's fairlife, McDonald's, The UPS Store, Cincinnati Children’s Hospital, Navy Federal Credit Union, Poland Spring and more.

Doner is part of DonerColle Partners, a strategic alliance with Colle McVoy built to help brands win between the coasts through integrated strategy, creative, media and AI-powered innovation.

For more information, visit doner.com and donercollepartners.com, and follow Doner and DonerColle Partners on LinkedIn.
